scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Heh? You brought all the items~
Okay, give me some time.
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
嘿？你把材料都带来了呀~
好的，请给我一点时间。

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
*Squish Squish Bang Bang Bang Tap Tap Scrape Scrape*
*Scratch Scratch Tap Tap Tap Tap*
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
*捏捏 砰砰砰 哒哒 刮刮*
*抓抓 哒哒哒哒*

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
*Squish Squish Bang Bang Bang Tap Tap Scrape Scrape*
*Scratch Scratch Tap Tap Tap Tap*
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
*捏捏 砰砰砰 哒哒 刮刮*
*抓抓 哒哒哒哒*

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Phew! There you go.
Now you can wear
Black Cat Ears
of your very own~
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
呼！完成了。
现在你可以戴上
属于你自己的
黑猫耳朵了~

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Thank you for using my service~!
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
感谢使用我的服务~！

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Umm...?
Excuse me?
Do I know you?...
Oh, I know why you
want to talk to me.
Heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
嗯...？
请问？
我认识你吗？...
哦，我知道你为什么
想和我说话了。
嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
You want to know where I got these tiny little cute black cat ears on my head, don't you? I knew it! Hahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
你是想知道我头上这双可爱小巧的黑猫耳朵是从哪里来的，对吧？我就知道！哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Well, I made these myself.
If you want, I can make one for you too for a small price.
Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
嗯，这些是我自己做的。
如果你想要的话，我也可以花点小钱为你做一个。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Neko Neko]
Just bring me
1 ^FF0000Kitty Band^000000,
1 ^FF0000Black Dyestuffs^000000,
200 ^FF0000Fluff^000000 and
^FF000010,000 zeny^000000!

[Neko Neko]
^FF0000Just remember, if you bring me any item that has a card inserted, or has been upgraded, the additional abilities of the item will disappear after I have used them. So please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[猫猫]
^FF0000请记住，如果你给我任何插了卡片或经过强化的物品，在我使用之后，这些附加能力将会消失。所以请务必留意这一点。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Hey~ why are you carrying so many items?
You mind sharing them with me?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
嘿~ 你身上怎么带了这么多东西？
介意分我一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Man, oh man~
Am I bored~!
If I only knew more tricks with this yo-yo. Then I could really impress the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
天哪，天哪~
我好无聊~！
要是我能学会更多悠悠球的技巧就好了。那样我就能真正迷倒女士们了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Impress the ladies...?

[Argen]
Yeah dude. There are two things chicks dig. Small, adorable presents. And suave dudes.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
没错，兄弟。女生喜欢两样东西。小巧可爱的礼物。还有风度翩翩的帅哥。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
So, I got the cutesy present junk down. You know, instead of like, spending money on like a real gift, I make these little hairpin thingees.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
所以，我擅长准备那种可爱的礼物。你知道的，与其花大钱买真正的礼物，我更喜欢做这种小发饰。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
As for being suave? Well, I do have this yo-yo...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
至于风度翩翩嘛？嗯，我确实有个悠悠球...

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Heh. You look like you don't like wasting cash on girls either. I'm down with that. If you like, I can make you a hairpin that you can give as gifts to the ^FF3333ladies^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
嘿。看起来你也不喜欢把钱花在女生身上。我理解你。如果你愿意，我可以给你做一个发饰，你可以把它作为礼物送给 ^FF3333女士们^000000。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
All you gotta do is bring me the stuff to make it. And if that hairpin's for yourself, well, I'm down with that jive too.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
你只需要把做发饰的材料带给我就行。如果那个发饰是给你自己用的，嗯，我也没意见。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Whoa~! A lady...
Wow, you're really cute! Tell you what...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
哇~！一位女士...
哇，你真可爱！这样吧...

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Since you're such a cutie, I'll put together a nice little hairpin for you. All you gotta do is bring me the stuff to make it.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
既然你这么可爱，我就为你做一个漂亮的小发饰吧。你只需要把做发饰的材料带给我就行。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
So go ahead and tell me what kinda hairpin you're interested in.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
那么，告诉我你想做哪种发饰吧。

scripts.text: ^3131FFX Hairpin^000000
^3131FFBand Aid^000000
^3131FFFlower Hairpin^000000
No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
X Hairpin!
Nice choice~!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
X字发夹！
好眼光~！

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Ah... Right.
About the Stellar...
^CE3100If you use an upgraded Stellar to make this item, any upgrades will be lost. That okay with you?^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
啊...对了。
关于星石...
^CE3100如果你使用升级过的星石来制作这个物品，升级效果将会消失。这样可以吗？^000000

scripts.text: I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text: I will come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Alright, let's get to work.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
好的，开工了。

scripts.text:
^3131FF * Scrape Scrape * ^000000
^3131FF * Scrape Scrape * ^000000

[Argen]
Alright, I'm done!
So what do you think?
Pretty cool, eh?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
好了，完成了！
你觉得怎么样？
挺酷的吧？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
No problem, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
没问题，慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Oh~
You want a ^3131FFX Hairpin?^000000
That's easy!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
哦~
你想要一个 ^3131FFX字发夹^000000？
这很简单！

scripts.text:
[Argen]
I need ^FF00001 Stellar^000000
and ^FF0000400 Ectoplasm^000000.
Tell me when you're ready!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
我需要 ^FF00001 星石^000000
和 ^FF0000400 幽灵^000000。
准备好了就告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Band Aid, eh?
Got it! Hold on
a sec, I'll be
done in a bit.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
创可贴，是吗？
明白了！稍等一下，
我马上就好。

scripts.text:
^3131FF * Scrape Scrape * ^000000
^3131FF * Scrape Scrape * ^000000

[Argen]
*Whew~!*
I'm finished!
Pretty cool, huh?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
*呼~！*
完成了！
挺酷的吧？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Ah, a ^3131FFBand Aid^000000!
That stuff is great for faking injuries, or hiding a bald spot. Handy to have when you wanna ditch school.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
啊，是 ^3131FF创可贴^000000！
这东西用来假装受伤或者遮住秃顶都很棒。想逃课的时候用得上。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Bring me ^FF00001 Alcohol^000000 and
^FF0000500 Rotten Bandage^000000!
Tell me when you're ready, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
给我 ^FF00001 酒精^000000 和
^FF0000500 腐烂绷带^000000！
准备好了告诉我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
You wanna a Flower Hairpin~?
Alright, gimmie a minute, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
你想要一个花卉发夹~？
好的，给我一分钟，好吗？

scripts.text:
^3131FF - Scrape Scrape - ^000000
^3131FF - Scrape Scrape - ^000000

[Argen]
Ah... It's done!
Hey, that looks pretty smooth! Oh, and uh, you can keep this leftover Stem.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
啊...完成了！
嘿，看起来挺光滑的！哦，对了，这根剩下的茎你可以留着。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
You wanna a ^3131FFFlower Hairpin^000000!
Yeah, I've noticed cuties just love walking around with flowers in their mouths, and I was always like 'Whaaaat~?' But then I got this great idea!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
你想要一个 ^3131FF花卉发夹^000000！
没错，我注意到可爱的女生们就喜欢嘴里叼着花到处走，我一直都在想“这都什么呀~？”不过后来我灵机一动，想到了个好主意！

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Wouldn't some kinda... ^3131FFFlower Hairpin^000000 be a hit with chicks? So I tried making one, and it seemed to be pretty popular among my lady friends.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
要是做个 ^3131FF花卉发夹^000000 之类的，肯定很受欢迎吧？所以我试着做了一个，结果在我那些女性朋友中还挺火的。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
And it's a much better way to use a flower than to put it on Pet Orc Warriors. Man, those things just look gnarly~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
而且，比起把花插在宠物兽人战士头上，这绝对是更好的用法。天哪，那样看起来太恶心了~

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Well, if you want one, I'll make it. But I want you should pay me some royalties for my services. It's pretty hard to attach a flower to a hairpin, you know?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
好吧，如果你想要的话，我就给你做一个。不过你得付我一点服务费，毕竟把花固定在发夹上挺难的，你知道吧？

scripts.text:
[Argen]
It takes mad skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
这可是需要高超技巧的。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
So, I want you to bring...
^FF00001 Romantic Flower^000000,
^FF000010 Steel^000000
and ^3131FF20,000 zeny^000000!
Got it? Cool~

[Argen]
I'm down with that.
If you want some kinda hairpin, just come back. I'll just be here, looking ^FF3333suaaave^000000 with this yo-yo.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
没问题。
如果你想要发夹，随时回来找我。我就在这里，拿着悠悠球，摆着 ^FF3333超帅^000000 的姿势。

scripts.text:
[Argen]
Feel free to come ask me if you want more hairpins. Hey, I know I look lazy, but I do like to make things for the ladies. See ya later~!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔根]
如果你想要更多发夹，尽管来找我。嘿，我知道我看起来有点懒散，但我确实喜欢为女士们制作东西。回头见~！

scripts.text:

- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
What's this?!
You've already brought everything I've asked! Good job, hero~! Let me get to work right away...
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
这是什么？！
你已经把我要求的东西都带来了！干得好，英雄~！让我马上开始工作...

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
...
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
...

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
......

[Zhenbolt]
......*Cling*

[Zhenbolt]
Take this...
It's known as the ^FF0000Hot-blooded Headband^000000, my personal symbol of fighting spirit! With this on your head, nothing can stop you!
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
拿着这个...
这就是 ^FF0000热血发圈^000000，我战斗精神的象征！戴上它，没有什么能阻挡你！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Now, go!
Unleash your fighting spirit upon the villains of the world!
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
现在，去吧！
向世间的恶棍们释放你的战斗精神吧！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
I...
am called ^FF0000Zhenbolt^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
我...
就是 ^FF0000振博尔特^000000！！

scripts.text: THE Zhenbolt!?
scripts.translation: 是振博尔特？！

scripts.text: Oh my gosh, it's Zhenbolt!
scripts.translation: 天哪，是振博尔特！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Yes, it is I, the man who has pummelled over a trillion foes and rising. Raging Hurricane Hero of Justice: Zhenbolt!
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
没错，就是我，那个击溃了万亿敌人并不断崛起的人。狂暴飓风正义英雄：振博尔特！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
I see in your eyes that you also fight with a heart of purity, a heart of passion!
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
我从你的眼中看到，你也拥有一颗纯洁的心，一颗充满激情的心！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
It is decided! If you bring me the following items, I will give you the famous symbol of battle by which villains fear Zhenbolt.
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
决定了！如果你能带给我以下物品，我就把那个让恶棍们闻风丧胆的著名战斗象征——振博尔特的标志给你。

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Bring me...
300 ^FF0000Red Muffler^000000,
300 ^FF0000Burning Heart^000000,
1 ^FF0000Bandana^000000 and 1 ^FF0000White Dyestuffs^000000.
That's all I need.

[Zhenbolt]
Come back soon, adventurer!
I expect great things of you!
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
快点回来，冒险者！
我对你寄予厚望！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Yes.
It is I, Zhenbolt.
Warrior of Might!
Whirling Tempest
of Raging Passion!
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
没错。
是我，振博尔特。
力量之战士！
狂暴激情的旋风风暴！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
I see in your eyes that you have seen many a skirmish. To have survived this long, you must know the secret to victory...
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
我从你的眼中看出，你经历过无数战斗。能存活至今，你一定知道胜利的秘诀...

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Pure, unbridled rage!
Battles are won with vigor and passion!
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
纯粹、不受束缚的愤怒！
战斗是靠活力和激情赢得的！

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Seeing as you understand this fundamental, I recognize you as an ally in the eternal struggle for justice! I shall bestow upon you the very symbol with which I have struck fear into evil hearts...
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
既然你理解了这个根本，我承认你是正义永恒斗争中的盟友！我将赐予你那个让我在邪恶心中种下恐惧的象征...

scripts.text:
[Zhenbolt]
Bring me
300 ^FF0000Red Muffler^000000,
300 ^FF0000Burning Heart^000000,
1 ^FF0000Bandana^000000 and 1 ^FF0000White Dyestuffs^000000.
That's all I need.

[Zhenbolt]
Bring me those items...
And you too can become a fighting legend...
scripts.translation:
[振博尔特]
把这些物品带给我...
你也能成为战斗的传奇...

- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Oh...
You've brought all these ribbons! I can't wait to tie you a new ribbon to put on your ^FF66CCbeautiful hair!^000000
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
哦...
你带了这么多发带！我迫不及待想给你系一条新发带，配你^FF66CC美丽的头发^000000！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
...

[Nephia]
......

[Nephia]
.......*Cling*

[Nephia]
That's it~! We're done! Oh, I just know you're going to look precious wearing this.
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
好了~！完成了！我知道你戴上这个一定非常可爱。

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Hopefully, we can get together and do each other's hair sometime! Wouldn't that be soooo much fun?
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
希望我们以后能聚在一起互相做发型！那一定非常非常有趣！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Wow~
Such beautiful hair! I'm sorry, it's just that I love pretty hairstyles, and accessories!
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
哇~
这么漂亮的头发！抱歉，我只是太喜欢漂亮的发型和配饰了！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Ooh~! You know what would make your hair so much cuter? I think if you tied it back with a big, red ribbon, you would look sooo ^FF66CCadorable^000000!
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
噢~！你知道什么能让你的头发更可爱吗？我觉得如果你用一条大大的红色发带扎起来，你会看起来非常^FF66CC可爱^000000！

scripts.text: Um, lady, I'm a dude.
scripts.translation: 呃，女士，我是个男的。

scripts.text: ^FF66CCOoh~! You're right!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF66CC噢~！你说得对！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Woman, can't you that I'm a man?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
女士，难道看不出我是个男人吗？

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Awww...
But you would look so ^FF66CCpretty~!^000000
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
哎呀...
但你戴上一定会非常^FF66CC漂亮~！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That...
Was the worst
compliment anyone
has ever given me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这...
是我听过的
最糟糕的
赞美了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oooh~!
That sounds great!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢~！
听起来很棒！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Like, oh my God! That's what I was thinking! Oh hey~! I can go ahead and tie that ribbon for you if you want!
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
天哪！我就是这么想的！嘿~！如果你愿意的话，我现在就可以帮你把发带系好！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Ooh! Bring...
1 ^FF0000Big Ribbon^000000,
1 ^FF0000slotted Ribbon^000000 and
1 ^FF0000Silk Ribbon^000000!

[Nephia]
Oh, I almost forgot!
^FF0000If you bring me any upgraded items, or items compounded with cards, those cards and upgrades will be lost once I create the new item for you. So please don't forget that!^000000
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
哎呀，我差点忘了！
^FF0000如果你给我带来任何升级过的物品，或者镶嵌了卡片的物品，一旦我为你制作新物品，这些卡片和升级效果将会丢失。所以请千万不要忘记这一点！^000000

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Ooh, hurry hurry! I can't wait to accessorize your hair!
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
噢，快一点快一点！我都等不及要给你的头发做装饰了！

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: ^FF66CCOoh~! You're right!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF66CC噢~！你说得对！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Er...
No thanks.

[Nephia]
Awwww~
But you're just the cutest little thing. I just know you would look so preeeetty!
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
哎呀~
但你真是最可爱的小家伙。我敢肯定你戴上一定会非常漂亮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oooh~!
That sounds great!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢~！
听起来很棒！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Like, oh my God! That's what I was thinking! Oh hey~! I can go ahead and tie a ribbon for you if you want!
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
天哪！我就是这么想的！嘿~！如果你愿意的话，我现在就可以帮你系一条发带！

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Ooh! To do that I need
1 ^FF0000Big Ribbon^000000,
1 ^FF0000slotted Ribbon^000000 and
1 ^FF0000Silk Ribbon^000000!
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
噢！要做到这一点，我需要
1个^FF0000红蝶发带^000000，
1个^FF0000带孔发带^000000，

scripts.translation:

^FF0000如果你给我带来任何升级过的物品，或者镶嵌了卡片的物品，一旦我为你制作新物品，这些卡片和升级效果将会丢失。所以请千万不要忘记这一点！^000000

scripts.text:
[Nephia]
Ooh, hurry hurry! I can't wait to accessorize your hair!
scripts.translation:
[内菲娅]
噢，快一点快一点！我都等不及要给你的头发做装饰了！

- too many items with you. -

- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -

等一下！

scripts.text:
[Meruntei]
Oh! You brought all of them! Now I shall make you an Indian Headband of your very own.
scripts.translation:
[梅伦泰]
噢！你全都带来了！现在我要为你制作一条专属的印地安发圈。

scripts.text:
[Meruntei]
Take this! The items you have brought will be very useful for continuing my work in spreading headbands around Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[梅伦泰]
拿着！你带来的物品将对我继续在中土世界推广发带的工作非常有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Meruntei]
iiiyiyiyiyiyiyiiiiii~~!
scripts.translation:
[梅伦泰]
耶耶耶耶耶耶耶~~！

scripts.text:
[Meruntei]
iiiyiyiyiyiyiyiiiiii~~!
 
Indian spirit, forever~!

[梅伦泰]
耶耶耶耶耶耶耶~~！
 
印地安精灵，永恒~！
代表克魔岛印地安人，我向所有印地安部落致敬！

[Meruntei]
Would you like to have an Indian Headband? You wouldn't become an official member of my tribe, but wearing it would show your respect if you happen to encounter tribal Indians in your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[梅伦泰]
你想要一条印地安发圈吗？虽然你不会成为我部落的正式成员，但如果你佩戴它，在冒险中遇到部落印地安人时，将能表达你的敬意。

scripts.text:
[Meruntei]
You could just bring...
1 ^FF0000Indian Fillet^000000,
1 ^FF0000Striped Hairband^000000,
10 ^FF0000PecoPeco Feather^000000
and ^FF000010,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[梅伦泰]
你只需要带上...
1个 ^FF0000印地安发箍^000000，
1个 ^FF0000条纹发带^000000，
10个 ^FF0000七彩大嘴鸟之羽^000000
以及 ^FF000010,000 Zeny 就可以了！

scripts.text:
[Meruntei]
I will be using the items you've given me so I can continue my work in spreading Indian Headbands, and paying homage to the tribes of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[梅伦泰]
我会使用你给我的物品，以便继续推广印地安发圈，并向中土世界的部落致敬。

scripts.text:
[Meruntei]
^FF0000For your information, if you bring me any item that has a card inserted, or has been upgraded, the additional abilities of the item will disappear after I have used them. So please keep that in mind.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅伦泰]
^FF0000请注意，如果你给我带来任何镶嵌了卡片的物品，或者升级过的物品，在我使用它们后，物品的附加能力将会消失。所以请牢记这一点。^000000

scripts.text:
[Meruntei]
iiiyiyiyiyiyiyiiiiii~~!
scripts.translation:

- too many items with you. -

- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -

[Ipore]
Wow! Did you really gather these 300 Mushroom Spores all by yoruself? Nice! Now it's time to use my magic~
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
哇！你真的独自收集了这300个香菇芽孢吗？太棒了！现在该使用我的魔法了~

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Sprinkle Sprinkle*
Ipore pours the Mushroom Spores onto your head.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*撒撒撒撒*
伊波雷将香菇芽孢撒在你的头上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
Hocus pocus!
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
呼哈呼哈！

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
.......................
Phew! Success! There's a mushroom growing out of your head!

[Ipore]
But...
I don't like the way it's tilting. It should have grown in the ^FF3333other^000000 direction.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
但是...
我不喜欢它倾斜的样子。它应该朝^FF3333另一个方向^000000生长才对。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
I guess...
I guess we should make that mushroom into a headband so that you can adjust it to your style.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
我想...
我想我们应该把这朵蘑菇做成发圈，这样你就可以根据自己的风格来调整它了。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
I know, I know...
It's not as cool as having the mushroom actually attached to your skull, but it's all we can do. I'm sorry I let you down.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
我知道，我知道...
这不像蘑菇直接长在头骨上那么酷，但这也是我们唯一能做的了。抱歉让你失望了。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
...There.
It's done. But are you okay? Luckily, I don't think I scalped you.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
...好了。
完成了。不过你没事吧？幸好，我觉得我没有把你头皮削掉。

[Ipore]

scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]

[Ipore]

I've created a magic spell that can make mushrooms grow anywhere! Anyplace you can imagine, I can make a mushroom grow there.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
终于...
我创造了一个能让蘑菇在任何地方生长的魔法！任何你能想象的地方，我都能让蘑菇在那里生长。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
Even...
On top of the human head...
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
甚至...
在人的头顶上...

scripts.text:
[Ipore]
Some may think it grotesque, but wouldn't you agree that sporting a mushroom, grown from your head, would start an art revolution?
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
有些人可能觉得这很怪诞，但你不觉得头上长出一朵蘑菇，能掀起一场艺术革命吗？

scripts.text:
[Ipore]

Man and mushroom?
Ah...I've piqued your curiosity I see.
scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
想想看！这是魔法与艺术、时尚与生活的完美融合...

啊...看来我勾起了你的好奇心。

[Ipore]

[伊波雷]
好了好了，你应该明白，我必须让蘑菇从你的头上长出来。如果长在其他地方，你可能会怀疑其中有什么把戏或幻觉。

scripts.text:
[Ipore]

scripts.translation:
[伊波雷]
而且，没有什么比头上长出一朵蘑菇更能体现“无因之反叛”了！你会看起来超级酷，独立且反主流文化！

^FF0000300 Mushroom Spore^000000,

Alright...
Let's get a groove on!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
好了...
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
There you go, buddy.
I am proud to say this is my masterpiece. Please take this item. I call it... 'Devil Wing Ears!'
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
好了，巴迪。
我很自豪地说，这是我的杰作。请收下这个物品。我把它叫做...“恶魔翅膀耳饰”！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
You'll be wowing everyone on the streets with your fashionable new look that says 'It feels so good to be so bad.' Glad to be of service~!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
你这一身时髦的新造型，绝对会让街上所有人都惊叹不已，仿佛在说“坏得如此有型，感觉真棒”。很高兴能为您服务~！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I'm sorry buddy, but I can't make this item without having the things I need. Remember, I need 1 Devil Wing, 1 Elven Ears and 20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
抱歉，巴迪，没有材料我没法制作这个物品。记住，我需要1个恶魔发圈、1个妖精长耳朵饰和20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
No problem.
Come back anytime you want.
I'll just be here enjoying the view.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
没问题。
随时欢迎回来。
我就在这里欣赏风景。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Of course, I can make an item
out of an Angel Wing as well!
That sort of thing is simple for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
当然，我也可以用天使发圈来制作物品！
对我来说，这种事很简单！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Okay then, then I'll need...
1 Angel Wing,
1 Elven Ears,
...and 20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
那么，我需要...
1个天使发圈，
1个妖精长耳朵饰，
...还有20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I must say this is a very cheap price considering the item I will make for you. But before I start, I should tell you...
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
考虑到我要为你制作的物品，不得不说这个价格非常便宜。不过在我开始之前，我得告诉你...

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I don't care how many times you've upgraded the items you brought, but please ^4d4dff carry only items that you need to create this item.^000000 I can't mess up my artwork because of some mistake you might make.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
不管你把带来的物品强化了多少次，请^4d4dff只携带制作这件物品所需的物品^000000。我可不能因为你的失误而毁了我的杰作。

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了。

scripts.text: Okay, let me go store my other items first.
scripts.translation: 好的，让我先去把其他物品存起来。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Ouch, why are you carrying
so many items with you?
Leave all your extra baggage somewhere else and come back.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
哎呀，你为什么带着这么多物品？
把多余的行李都放到别处，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
Alright...
Let's get a groove on!
scripts.translation:
好的...
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
There you go, buddy.
I am proud to say this is my masterpiece. Please take this item. I call it... 'Angel Wing Ears!'
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
好了，巴迪。
我很自豪地说，这是我的杰作。请收下这个物品。我把它叫做...“天使翅膀耳饰”！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
There's no doubt that you'll be the talk of the town sporting these fashionable things.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
毫无疑问，戴着这些时尚饰品的你，会成为整个城镇的话题。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
The glamour of an angel and the cuteness of Elven Ears is almost too much goodness for one headgear~!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
天使的光彩加上妖精长耳朵饰的可爱，简直好过头了~！

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I'm sorry buddy, but I can't make this item without having the things I need. Remember, I need 1 Angel Wing, 1 Elven Ears and 20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
抱歉，巴迪，没有我需要的材料，我没法制作这件物品。记住，我需要1个天使发圈、1个妖精长耳朵饰和20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
No problem.
Come back anytime you want.
 
I'll just be here enjoying the view.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
没问题。
随时欢迎回来。
 
我就在这里欣赏风景。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I happened to come to Juno while I was traveling around the world. Being someplace up in the clouds makes me a little nervous, but still, the scenery looks great from up here.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
我在环游世界时偶然来到了朱诺。虽然身处云端让我有点紧张，但这里的风景确实很棒。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Although I really enjoy traveling more than staying in my shop, I'm still a Blacksmith at heart and I always gotta be making something. It's been a while since I've made my last creation...
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
虽然我更喜欢旅行而不是待在店里，但我骨子里还是个铁匠，总得做点什么。距离我上次创作已经有一段时间了...

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Hmm...
If I had some materials, I think I could put together some pretty amazing stuff.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
嗯...
如果我有材料的话，我觉得可以打造出相当惊艳的作品。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
If by any chance, you have an Angel Wing or Evil Wing, and
Elven Ears, would you give me a chance to smith something?
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
如果你碰巧有天使发圈或恶魔发圈，以及妖精长耳朵饰，能给我个机会打造点东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
I was thinking...
Elven Ears are great...
And everyone loves Angel Wing or Devil Wing. Wouldn't it be totally fab if I could combine the Elven Ears with one of the wings?!
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
我在想...
妖精长耳朵饰很棒...
而且大家都喜欢天使发圈或恶魔发圈。如果我能把妖精长耳朵饰和其中一种发圈结合起来，那该多酷啊！

scripts.text: Give me more information.
scripts.translation: 给我更多信息。

scripts.text: Yeah, I will think about it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Oh, right.
Let me tell
you exactly I need.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
哦，对了。
让我告诉你
我具体需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
For creating Angel Wing Ears, I need 1 ^4d4dffAngel Wing^000000,
1 ^4d4dffElven Ears^000000 and
^4d4dff20,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
要打造天使翅膀耳饰，我需要1个^4d4dff天使发圈^000000，
1个^4d4dff妖精长耳朵饰^000000，以及
^4d4dff20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
For creating Devil Wing Ears,
I need 1 ^4d4dffDevil Wing^000000,
1 ^4d4dffElven Ears^000000 and
^4d4dff20,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
要打造恶魔翅膀耳饰，
我需要1个^4d4dff恶魔发圈^000000，
1个^4d4dff妖精长耳朵饰^000000，以及
^4d4dff20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
Come back anytime when you have those materials.
I will let you have either the elegance of an angel or the charisma of a demon with the wearables only I can craft.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
等你准备好材料后，随时回来找我。
我会让你拥有只有我能打造的饰品，让你尽显天使的优雅或恶魔的魅力。

scripts.text:
[Hatbyr Mhore]
No problem.
I'm always here at this scenic spot so I can enjoy the view. Just come back whenever you feel like it.
scripts.translation:
[哈特比尔·莫尔]
没问题。
我一直在这个风景优美的地方，可以欣赏美景。你想什么时候回来都行。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
I know you brought everything you need for me to make you a hat, but you're carrying too much stuff. Why don't you put some of your things in Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
我知道你带齐了给我做帽子所需的所有材料，但你身上带的东西太多了。为什么不把一些东西存进卡普拉仓库呢？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Whoa~
You brought everything!
Okay, hold on a bit.
Let me make your hat.
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
哇~
你全都带来了！
好的，请稍等。
让我来给你做帽子。

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
As my mom taught me,
put this down on the ground...
Okay, I am ready...
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
就像我妈妈教我的那样，
把这个放在地上...
好了，我准备好了...

scripts.text: ^FF0000Lindsay put the Raccoon Hat on the ground, threw the Smokie Leaf onto the hat and mumbled some words while hugging herself.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000林赛把狸猫帽放在地上，将变身树叶扔在帽子上，然后抱着自己小声念了几句咒语。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Then, suddenly with a dazzling light, the Raccoon Hat turned blue and slowly transformed into a Sea-Otter Hat.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000接着，突然闪过一道耀眼的光芒，狸猫帽变成了蓝色，并慢慢变成了一顶海獭帽。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Phew! It's done!
Gosh! I think I
spent all my energy.
Okay, take this~
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
呼！完成了！
天哪！我觉得
我把所有力气都用光了。
好了，给你~

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
I made this hat with all my heart, so you gotta promise me you will take care of this, okay?
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
这顶帽子是我用心制作的，所以你一定要答应我好好珍惜它，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Hello, there?
Mister...?
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
你好？
先生...？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
You look like you're freezing...
Um, I know! How about I make you a cute, warm and fuzzy Sea-Otter hat?
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
你看起来好像很冷...
嗯，我知道了！要不要我给你做一顶可爱又温暖的海獭帽？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
It's really really cute! Also, it's the only hat I know how to make, because I love playing with Sea Otters so much!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
它真的超级可爱！而且，这是我唯一会做的帽子，因为我非常喜欢和海獭玩耍！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
I have to put together ^0000FF1 Raccoon Hat^000000 and ^0000FF1 Smokie Leaf^000000 to make a ^4D4DFFSea-Otter Hat^000000 for you, though.
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
不过，我需要把^0000FF1个狸猫帽^000000和^0000FF1片变身树叶^000000组合起来，才能为你打造一顶^4D4DFF海獭帽^000000。

scripts.text: Okay, I will come back with the stuff.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会带着材料回来的。

scripts.text: Um... How come you need a Raccoon Hat?
scripts.translation: 嗯...为什么你需要狸猫帽？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Cool~! Come back soon as you can~!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
酷~！尽快回来哦~！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Well, it's supposed to be a seeeecret, but my mommy taught me some magic to make Sea-Otter hats with Raccoon hats.
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
虽然这本来是个秘密啦，但我妈妈教了我一种魔法，可以用狸猫帽做出海獭帽。

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
It's the bestest magic ever because it comes from my heart!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
这是最棒的魔法，因为它出自我的真心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That...
That still doesn't explain anything!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这...这根本解释不通啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright...
Yeah...
I'll come back later, kid.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧...行吧...我晚点再回来，小孩。

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Hello, hello~!
You're such a pretty lady!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
你好，你好~！
你真是位漂亮的女士！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Hey hey! Can I make you a Sea-Otter hat! It's really really really really cute!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
嘿！我可以为你做一顶海獭帽吗？它真的超级超级超级超级可爱！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
I need ^0000FF1 Raccoon Hat^000000 and ^0000FF1 Smokie Leaf^000000 so I can make a ^4D4DFFSea-Otter Hat^000000 for you.
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
我需要^0000FF1个狸猫帽^000000和^0000FF1片变身树叶^000000，才能为你打造一顶^4D4DFF海獭帽^000000。

scripts.text: Okay, I will come back with the stuff.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会带着材料回来的。

scripts.text: Um, why do you want to make hats so much?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你为什么这么想做帽子？

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Cool~!
Come back as
soon as you can~!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
酷~！
尽快回来哦~！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
Because...!
If everyone in Lutie was wearing a fuzzy Sea-Otter cap, it would look so so cute!
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
因为...！
如果姜饼城的每个人都戴着毛茸茸的海獭帽，那一定超级超级可爱！

scripts.text:
[Pretty Lindsay]
We could play games in the snow, and play with real Sea Otters and have them give us rides and...
.....
scripts.translation:
[漂亮的 林赛]
我们可以在雪地里玩游戏，还可以和真正的海獭玩耍，让它们载我们兜风，还有...

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
You brought every material I need, but unfortunately you don't have enough space in your inventory. Try and place some of your items into Kafra Storage first.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
你带来了所有我需要的材料，但不幸的是你的背包空间不足。请先将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Excellent! You brought everything! Please make yourself comfortable while I make you your Teddybear Hat.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
太好了！你带来了所有材料！请坐好，我要开始为你制作小熊帽了。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Hmm Hm Hmm...
Tear this off...
Knit this on....
Okay, it's almost done...
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
嗯哼嗯哼...
把这里拆下来...
把这里缝上去....
好了，快完成了...

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
There is an old saying, 'Everything comes to those who wait.' Oh, are you freezing? Why don't you rub your hands together?
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
俗话说“好事多磨”。哦，你冷吗？不如搓搓手取暖吧？

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
It's complete! There you go. I think this one will look really good on you! Please take good care of this hat.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
完成了！给你。我觉得这顶帽子戴在你头上一定很好看！请好好珍惜这顶帽子。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Hello there, young man.
What brings you to Lutie, town of goodwill and year round Christmas cheer?
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
你好，年轻男子。
是什么风把你吹到了充满善意与全年圣诞欢愉的姜饼城？

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
I'm a master of creating stuffed animals, which make great presents. As we all know, everyone loves to hug cute and cuddly stuffed animals.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
我是制作毛绒玩具的大师，它们是很棒的礼物。众所周知，每个人都喜欢拥抱可爱又柔软的毛绒玩具。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
My specialty is the 'Teddybear Hat.' When it's worn, it makes you as cute as a teddy bear, and your hugs twice as warm and cuddly.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
我的拿手好戏是“小熊帽”。戴上它，你会变得像泰迪熊一样可爱，你的拥抱也会变得两倍温暖、两倍柔软。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
The 'Teddybear Hat' can't be worn by just anyone, since it's cuddling powers are easily abused.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
“小熊帽”并非人人皆可佩戴，因为它的拥抱力量很容易被滥用。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
I sense that you are an adventurer with a good heart, and that a sweet girl like you deserves a nice gift.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
我感觉到你是一位心地善良的冒险者，像你这样甜美的女孩值得拥有一份美好的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
But I sense that you are an adventurer with a pure heart and would not use the Teddybear Hat for selfish gain.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
但我感觉到你拥有一颗纯净的心，不会为了私利而滥用小熊帽。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
You can learn a lot about telling good people from the naughty after working for Santa for a loooong time...
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
在为圣诞老人工作这么...这么长的时间之后，我学会了如何分辨善良的人和淘气的人...

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
You know more about such things after working for Santa for so long.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
在为圣诞老人工作这么久之后，我对这些事情了解得更多。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Unfortunately, I don't have any material to make the headgear right now. But if you bring the materials, I will make you a 'Teddybear Hat' for free.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
不幸的是，我现在没有制作头饰的材料。但如果你带来材料，我会免费为你制作一顶“小熊帽”。

scripts.text:
[Fuzzy Fuzz]
Let's see...
I'll need...
^0000FF1 Panda Hat^000000,
^0000FF100 Needle Packet^000000,
^0000FF100 Spool^000000 and
^0000FF300 Black Bear Skin^000000.

[Fuzzy Fuzz]
So, do you think you can get all of them? I will be here waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[毛绒绒]
那么，你觉得你能找到所有这些东西吗？我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Hmmm...
You look like you're having trouble carrying all of your things. Why don't you place some of your extra items into the Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[南香]
嗯...
看起来你搬运这些东西有些吃力。为什么不多把一些多余的东西放进卡普拉仓库呢？

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Hello, there.
Ah, I can tell that you already have a ^8C1717'Model Training Hat'^000000. I see that using it has corrected your posture.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
你好。
啊，我看得出你已经拥有了一顶^8C1717矫正姿势之帽^000000。看来使用它已经矫正了你的姿势。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Oh...
I forgot to tell you that I can not only put together a 'Model Training Hat,' I can disassemble it into its original parts.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
哦...
我忘了告诉你，我不仅能组装“矫正姿势之帽”，还能将其拆解回原始部件。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
If you give me ^0000FF1 'Model Training Hat'^000000 and ^0000FF1 'Arrow'^000000, I give you ^8C17171 'Apple of Archer'^000000 and ^8C17171 'Book'^000000. So, would you like to disassemble the items?
scripts.translation:
[南香]
如果你给我^0000FF1矫正姿势之帽^000000和^0000FF1箭^000000，我会给你^8C1717苹果头饰^000000和^8C1717书^000000。那么，你想拆解这些物品吗？

scripts.text: Disassemble
scripts.translation: 拆解

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Thank you.
It will not take that much time to make this hat, so please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
谢谢。
制作这顶帽子不会花太多时间，请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
There you go.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
给你。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
If you want to make a
'Model Training Hat' again,
feel free to come back.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
如果你想再制作一顶
“矫正姿势之帽”，
随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I see.
I hope you will
continue to use that hat
to improve your posture
and glamorous poise.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
我明白了。
希望你能继续使用那顶帽子
来改善你的姿势
和优雅的风度。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
You brought the materials~
scripts.translation:
[南香]
你带来了材料~

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Before I start to create the item, I'm obligated to warn you...
scripts.translation:
[南香]
在我开始制作物品之前，我有义务提醒你...

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
If the ^FF0000'Book' and 'Apple of Archer' items you have brought to make a 'Model Training Hat' was ^FF0000upgraded^000000, after I create the hat out of the book, ^FF0000these upgrades, including compounded cards, will be lost.^000000
scripts.translation:
[南香]
如果您用来制作^FF0000“矫正姿势之帽”的“书本”和“苹果头饰”^FF0000是强化过的^000000，那么在我用书本制作帽子后，^FF0000这些强化效果，包括叠加的卡片，将会丢失。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hanhyang]
So would you like to create the Model Training Hat right now?
scripts.translation:
[韩香]
那么，您现在想要制作矫正姿势之帽吗？

scripts.text: Create
scripts.translation: 制作

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Thank you.
Let me create one for you right away. Please have a seat and make yourself comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
谢谢。
我这就为您制作一顶。请坐，请随意。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Usually we have a zeny service charge, but since you've got ^3355FFthe look^000000, I'll waive it.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
通常我们会收取Zeny服务费，但既然您拥有^3355FF那种气质^000000，我就免除了。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Please wait a moment while I put this together.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
请稍等，让我把它组装起来。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
That wasn't too difficult. I hope you wear this hat everyday to improve your posture.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
这并不难。希望您能每天戴着这顶帽子，以改善您的姿势。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
You may have trouble at first, keeping your balance and trying not to drop the apple. You may even feel incredible neck pain. But for the sake of beauty, it'll all be worth it.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
起初您可能会感到难以保持平衡，或者担心苹果掉下来。您甚至可能会感到颈部剧烈疼痛。但为了美丽，这一切都是值得的。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Here it is.
Oh, right, this arrow from the Apple of Archer is left over, so you can go ahead and take that.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
给您。
对了，这是制作苹果头饰时剩下的箭，您可以拿走了。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Also, I can disassemble the Model Training Hat into its original materials. So if you want the original items back, bring the Model Training Hat and the arrow I gave you.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
另外，我可以将矫正姿势之帽分解回原始材料。如果您想要回原始物品，请带上矫正姿势之帽和我给您的那支箭。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I hope you
will have a
good day.
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
祝您
度过美好的一天。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I see. You must have brought items with cards or upgrades that you didn't want to lose. Feel free to come back anytime when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
我明白了。您一定是带了镶嵌卡片或升级的物品，不想失去它们。当您准备好时，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Hello~
Welcome to the Handsome Charm Modeling School. May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[南香]
你好~
欢迎来到帅哥魅力模特学校。有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I want to be a model~!
scripts.translation: 我想成为模特~！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I see~
Although it's clear that you've got '^3355FFthe look^000000,' we can't accept any students at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
我明白了~
虽然很明显您拥有“^3355FF那种气质^000000”，但我们目前无法招收任何学生。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Lately, our director has been gone, and we aren't sure when he'll come back. ^333333*Sigh* I can't even remember the last time we got paid.^000000
scripts.translation:
[南香]
最近，我们的总监不在，我们不确定他什么时候回来。^333333*叹气* 我甚至记不清上次发工资是什么时候了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Hmm... Wait a minute!
At the very least, we could train you to improve your posture so that you can walk with regal poise.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
嗯... 等等！
至少，我们可以训练您改善姿势，让您能走出高贵优雅的步伐。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Although we can't offer any classes at this time, I can create a special 'Model Training Hat' for you. That way, you can practice the glamourous way of walking down the catwalk on your own.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
虽然我们现在无法提供课程，但我可以为您制作一顶特殊的“矫正姿势之帽”。这样，您就可以独自练习在T台上优雅走路的姿态了。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
But since our director is gone, we can't really use our budget to give you a hat. If you want, please bring me the following items...
scripts.translation:
[南香]
但由于我们的总监不在，我们无法动用预算为您提供帽子。如果您愿意，请带给我以下物品...

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
Please bring...
^0000FF1 Apple of Archer^000000 and
^0000FF1 Book^000000.
Then I can fashion a 'Model Training Hat' for you right away.
scripts.translation:
[南香]
请带来...
^0000FF1 苹果头饰^000000 和
^0000FF1 书^000000。
然后我就可以立刻为您制作一顶“矫正姿势之帽”。

scripts.text:
[Nanhyang]
I understand.
Well, have a good day.
Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[南香]
我明白了。
那么，祝您今天愉快。
谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Whoa, why are you carrying so many items with you?
You look so heavy...! Maybe you can walk more easily if you put some of your stuff away?
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
哇，你为什么带着这么多东西？
看起来好重...！把一些东西收起来，走起路来可能会轻松一点哦？

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Hello, my name is Seth!
I like folding paper and making origami. I made my mommy a big paper boat, and she gave me a big smile and patted my head!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
你好，我叫赛斯！
我喜欢折纸和做折纸。我给妈妈折了一只大纸船，她对我露出了大大的微笑，还摸了摸我的头！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Today at school, I learned how to make a paper flower! The flower was sort of hard, but now I can do it! Then I made a tiny tiny flower and put in on my head~
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
今天在学校，我学会了折纸花！纸花有点难，但我现在会了！然后我折了一朵小小的花，戴在了头上~

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Hey~!
You have a Mr. Smile and Scarlet Dyestuffs! Yaaay~! I could use those and make you a paper flower. C'mon, lemme show you!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
嘿~！
你有笑脸面具和红色染料！耶~！我可以用它们给你折一朵纸花。来吧，让我给你看看！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Lemme make
one for you,
pwease pwease?
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
让我给你折一个，
求求你啦？

scripts.text: Alright!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text: No thanks kid.
scripts.translation: 不用了，小孩。

scripts.text: Boys aren't supposed to make flowers.
scripts.translation: 男孩子不该折花。

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Yay~
You're the best!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
耶~
你最棒了！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Let's see...
I cut Mr. Smile this way~.
*Snip Snip Snip~~*
*Snip...Snip...*
Yyyyyaaaeeep...
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
让我看看...
我把笑脸面具这样剪开~。
*咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓~~*
*咔嚓...咔嚓...*
耶...耶耶耶...

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Tah dah~!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
当当~！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Heheheh~!
I'm done!
I did a good job, didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
嘿嘿嘿~！
我做好了！
我做得很好，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Oh, here's the leftovers. Mommy says that we should always save things. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
哦，这是剩下的部分。妈妈说我们要总是节约东西。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Seth]
I'm a good boy!
I'm gonna make one for my little sister~! And everybody I love!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
我是个好男孩！
我要给妹妹也折一个~！还有我爱的人！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
If you want to see me make another one, just bring more Scarlet Dyestuffs and Mr.Smile, okay? Bye bye~!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
如果你想看我再折一个，就带更多的红色染料和笑脸面具来，好吗？拜拜~！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
*Sniff sniff*
O-okay...
But I just wanted to show you how good I am...
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
*吸鼻子*
好...好吧...
但我只是想让你看看我有多厉害...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Boys aren't supposed to make flowers.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
男孩子不该折花。

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Waaaaaaah~!
But flowers are so nice and pweety!!!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
哇啊啊啊~！
但是花那么漂亮啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
You want me to show you? Huh?
I can do it you want!
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
你想让我展示给你看？哼？
只要你想要，我就可以做到！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Uh oh...
But I don't have anything to make paper flowers out of.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
哎呀...
但我没有可以用来折纸花的材料。

scripts.text: I'll get what you need.
scripts.translation: 我会去准备你需要的东西。

scripts.text: Too bad!
scripts.translation: 真可惜！

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Okay okay...
I neeeeed...
^3131FF1 Mr. Smile^000000 and
^3131FF1 Scarlet Dyestuffs^000000.
Then I can make you a tiiiiny little flower.
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
好啦好啦...
我需...需要...
^3131FF1笑脸面具^000000和
^3131FF1红色染料^000000。
这样我就能为你折一朵小小的花了。

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Seth will wait for you here. Promise me you'll come back?
scripts.translation:
[赛斯]
赛斯会在这里等你的。答应我你会回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Seth]
Wah~~~~~!

- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您现在携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Hey there. Um...
I'm the 'Mad Hatter.' Well, at least that's what I call myself.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
你好。那个...
我是“疯帽匠”。至少我是这么称呼自己的。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
If you give me some stuff, I can renovate some of your old hats so that they really show your personality. Whether you're laid back or a party animal, I'll be able to make a hat just for you!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
如果你给我一些材料，我可以改造你的一些旧帽子，让它们更能彰显你的个性。无论你是随性洒脱还是派对达人，我都能为你打造一顶专属的帽子！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
You wanna take a look at the trendy, stylish hats I can make for you?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
你想看看我能为你打造的时尚潮流帽子吗？

scripts.text: Party Hat
scripts.translation: 派对帽

scripts.text: Straw Hat
scripts.translation: 遮阳帽

scripts.text: Cowboy Hat
scripts.translation: 荒野之帽

scripts.text: Sombrero
scripts.translation: 宽边帽

scripts.text: Beanie
scripts.translation: 毛线帽

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Party Hat! It's a Santa Hat I've remade by adding colorful paper for a festive look. Celebrate good times with a Party Hat! Come on!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
派对帽！这是我在圣诞帽的基础上添加了彩色纸张，使其看起来更加喜庆的改造版。戴上派对帽，一起庆祝美好的时光吧！来吧！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
哦等等！在我们开始之前，请确认一件事。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
If the Santa Hat you use to create this hat was upgraded or compounded with a card, all those upgrades will be lost. So, to be safe, I suggest you put everything in your inventory, other than the things to make the Party Hat, into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
如果你用来制作这顶帽子的圣诞帽经过强化或镶嵌了卡片，所有的强化和卡片效果都会丢失。因此，为了安全起见，我建议你将除了制作派对帽所需材料以外的所有物品都存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
It seems to me that you have everything. Alright! Shall I make you a Party Hat?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
看起来你什么都准备好了。好的！要我为你制作一顶派对帽吗？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Umm, okay...
I guess being the life of the party is a bit too much for you, eh? Hmpf. Well, I know a good library in Juno where you can hang out...
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
嗯，好吧...
看来成为派对焦点对你来说有点太难了，是吗？哼。不过我知道朱诺有个不错的图书馆，你可以去那里逛逛...

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Rustle Rustle Splat Splat*^000000
^3355FF*Squick Squick Grind Grind*^000000
^3355FF*Swish Swish Rustle Rustle*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*沙沙 沙沙 啪嗒 啪嗒*^000000
^3355FF*吱扭 吱扭 咯吱 咯吱*^000000
^3355FF*唰唰 沙沙 沙沙 沙沙*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
It's done! Your new life, as the life of the party, has officially begun. All you need to do is wear this Party Hat. Though, knowing a couple jokes would probably help too.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
完成了！你作为派对焦点的新生活，正式开始了。你只需要戴上这顶派对帽。不过，要是能再学几个笑话，那就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh by the way, there's some stuff left over. I guess you should hold onto it. You know, in case you need it later.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
哦对了，还有一些剩下的材料。我想你应该留着它们。毕竟，以后说不定用得上呢。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh... man. Everyone needs a Party Hat! Even boring types get jazzed with pizazz wearing one of these!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
哎呀...天哪。每个人都想要一顶派对帽！即使是那些无趣的家伙，戴上它也会变得充满活力和魅力！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
You can wear them for birthday parties, Christmas parties. Um, slumber parties. P-political parties.
......
And hunting parties?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
你可以戴着它去参加生日派对、圣诞派对。嗯，还有睡衣派对。政...政治集会。
......
以及狩猎小队？

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Anyway, this is what I need to make a Party Hat...
1 ^3355FFSanta Hat^000000,
100 ^3355FFOil Paper^000000 and
100 ^3355FFSlick Paper^000000.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
总之，制作一顶派对帽需要以下材料...
1 ^3355FF圣诞帽^000000，
100 ^3355FF油纸^000000 和
100 ^3355FF光滑的纸^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
I'll be right here when you decide to crank your life up a notch with a Party Hat.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
当你决定用一顶派对帽来提升生活格调时，我会一直在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Straw Hat! Made out of a Sakkat with bamboo and tough vines, it gives you a relaxed, rustic feeling when you wear it.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
遮阳帽！由草帽、竹筒和强韧木藤条制成，戴上它会让你感到轻松惬意，充满田园气息。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
If the Sakkat you use to create this hat was upgraded, any cards, slots or upgrades will disappear once I make a new hat out of it.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
哦等等！在我们开始之前，请确认一件事。
如果你用来制作这顶帽子的草帽经过强化，那么一旦我将其制成新帽子，所有的卡片、插槽和强化效果都会消失。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
To be safe, I suggest you put everything else, other than the required hat items, into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
为了安全起见，我建议你将除了制作遮阳帽所需材料以外的所有物品都存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah! I see you brought everything. Alright! Do you want me to make you a Straw Hat now?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
啊！看来你带齐了所有材料。好的！要我现在就为你制作一顶遮阳帽吗？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Man...
I think you need this hat more than I thought. You have got to learn to just chill and relax~!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
天哪...
我觉得你比我想象的更需要这顶帽子。你一定要学会放松和享受悠闲的时光~！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Crunch Chew Chew Chew*^000000
^3355FF*Squish Squish Fwsht Fwsht*^000000
^3355FF*Crunch Crunch Tap Tap*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔嚓 咀嚼 咀嚼 咀嚼*^000000
^3355FF*噗嗤 噗嗤 嘶嘶 嘶嘶*^000000
^3355FF*咔嚓 咔嚓 哒哒 哒哒*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
It's done!
Now you can wear this hat, feel cool, and relax with style.
Please come again~
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
完成了！
现在你可以戴上这顶帽子，感受凉爽，优雅地放松身心。
欢迎再次光临~

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Straw Hat! It shades you from the heat of the sun and keeps farmers cool when they're working on the fields. It's a hat for cool, relaxed types and the hat of choice for some famous heroes!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
遮阳帽！它能为你遮挡烈日，让农夫在田间劳作时保持凉爽。它是那些追求凉爽、悠闲风格的人的首选，也是许多著名英雄的选择！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Anyways, I need all these to make you a Straw Hat...
1 ^3355FFSakkat^000000,
300 ^3355FFTough Vines^000000 and
300 ^3355FFPiece of Bamboo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
总之，为你制作一顶遮阳帽需要以下所有材料...
1 ^3355FF草帽^000000，
300 ^3355FF强韧木藤条^000000 和
300 ^3355FF竹筒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
I'll be right here when you decide that you want the perfect hat for laid back, kick back moods. Be cool~
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
当你决定想要一顶适合悠闲、放松心情的完美帽子时，我会一直在这里等你。保持酷~

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
I take a Western Grace, add some manliness, um, do some finangling, and Voila~! A Cowboy Hat!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
我拿一顶牛仔帽，加上一些阳刚之气，嗯，稍作调整，Voila~！一顶荒野之帽！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
It's a hat for adventure and exploration. Although it's a manly hat like no other, with a manly factor of 9, it also looks great on girls.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
这是一顶适合冒险和探索的帽子。虽然它有着无与伦比的阳刚之气，阳刚指数高达9，但戴在女孩头上也非常好看。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
If the Western Grace you use to create this hat was upgraded, any cards or upgrades will be lost once I make a new hat out of it.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
哦等等！在我们开始之前，请确认一件事。
如果你用来制作这顶帽子的牛仔帽经过强化，那么一旦我将其制成新帽子，所有的卡片和强化效果都会丢失。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
To be safe, I suggest you put everything, other than the required materials, into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
为了安全起见，我建议你将除必需材料以外的所有物品都存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah! You brought everything already. Excellent. Do you want me to make a Cowboy Hat now?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
啊！你已经把所有材料都带来了。真棒。你想让我现在就为你制作一顶荒野之帽吗？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Well, I see.
I guess you just don't appreciate the value of cowboy heroes, do you?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
好吧，我明白了。
看来你并不欣赏西部英雄的价值，是吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Clik-clak Clik-clak Pam Pam Pam Pam*^000000
^3355FF*Bang Bang Ping Ping*^000000
^3355FF*Uk Uk Uk Uk Uhoh Uhoh*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔哒咔哒 咔哒咔哒 砰 砰 砰 砰*^000000
^3355FF*砰 砰 叮 叮*^000000
^3355FF*呜 呜 呜 呜 哎呀 哎呀*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Yeeeeehaw! With this hat on, you can tame broncos, rob stagecoaches, and look really stylish in duels!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
耶嘿！戴上这顶帽子，你可以驯服烈马，抢劫马车，还能在决斗中看起来非常帅气！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Cowboy Hat! This is a very popular that brings up images of frontier life and gunplay.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
荒野之帽！这是一种非常流行的帽子，让人联想到边疆生活和枪战。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Wearing a Cowboy Hat will make guys look tougher and more heroic, and will add untamed cuteness to the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
戴上荒野之帽，男士们会看起来更硬朗、更具英雄气概，女士们则会增添几分野性的可爱。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
I need these items to make a Cowboy Hat...
1 ^3355FFWestern Grace^000000,
108 ^3355FFClaw of Desert Wolf^000000,
108 ^3355FFSoft Blade of Grass^000000 and
4 ^3355FFBurning Horseshoe^000000.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
制作荒野之帽需要以下物品...
1 ^3355FF牛仔帽^000000，
108 ^3355FF沙漠之狼之指甲^000000，
108 ^3355FF柔软的草叶^000000 和
4 ^3355FF燃烧的马蹄铁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
So when you decide to give your life a boost with rustic style, come back to me with those items so I can make you a Cowboy Hat.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
所以，当你决定用乡村风格提升生活格调时，带着这些物品回来找我，我会为你制作一顶荒野之帽。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah yes. Now here's a classy hat for mariachi heroes and Latin lovers. You can't deny the sex appeal that just pours from someone wearing a Sombrero.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
啊，是的。现在，这是一顶适合流浪乐队英雄和拉丁情人的优雅帽子。戴着宽边帽的人所散发出的魅力是无法否认的。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
If the Straw Hat you use to creating this hat was upgraded, any cards or upgrades in this hat will be lost once I make the Sombrero.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
哦等等！在我们开始之前，请确认一件事。
如果你用来制作这顶帽子的遮阳帽经过强化，那么一旦我将其制成宽边帽，所有的卡片和强化效果都会丢失。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
To be safe, I suggest you put everything you don't need to make this hat into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
为了安全起见，我建议你将除制作这顶帽子所需的物品以外的所有东西都存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah! You brought everything already. Alright! Do you want me to make you a Sombrero right away?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
啊！你已经把所有材料都带来了。好的！你想让我马上为你制作一顶宽边帽吗？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Fine, fine.
But think of all the sex appeal you're missing out on. Come on, you know you need a Sombrero.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
好吧，好吧。
但想想你错过了多少魅力吧。拜托，你知道你需要一顶宽边帽的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFZinga Zinga Zang Zang^000000
^3355FFDing Ding Ding Dan Dan Dan^000000
^3355FFAdios Amigo^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFZinga Zinga Zang Zang^000000
^3355FFDing Ding Ding Dan Dan Dan^000000
^3355FFAdios Amigo^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
With this Sombrero, you'll look like you have all kinds of style. Adios, cool guy~
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
戴上这顶宽边帽，你会看起来非常有型。再见了，酷哥~

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Now, everyone needs a Sombrero. They're one of the most versatile hats in existence. You can wear them to formal events, you can wear them while napping, you can wear them just to hang out...
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
现在，每个人都需要一顶宽边帽。它是现存最通用的帽子之一。你可以戴它参加正式场合，可以在小睡时戴它，也可以只是戴着它闲逛...

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Look, you don't need me to explain how cool a Sombrero is. It's just one of those things that everyone naturally knows. So I know you want one.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
看，我不需要解释宽边帽有多酷。这是大家天生就知道的事情。所以我知道你想要一顶。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
So this is what I need to make a Sombrero...
1 ^3355FFStraw Hat^000000,
50 ^3355FFCactus Needle^000000 and
1 ^3355FFGuitar^000000.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
所以，制作宽边帽需要以下物品...
1 ^3355FF遮阳帽^000000，
50 ^3355FF仙人掌刺^000000 和
1 ^3355FF吉他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
That's all you need to have the coolest hat ever.
(Woohoo~!)
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
拥有这些，你就能拥有最酷的帽子了。
（万岁~！）

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Beanie...!
Whaddup, broham. This hat keeps your head toasty, but let's you play things cool with your homeys. And, um, fly girls.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
针织帽...！
嘿，兄弟。这顶帽子能保暖，但也能让你和哥们儿一起耍酷。还有，呃，吸引女孩。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Oh wait! Please check one thing before we start.
If the Cap you use to make this Beanie was upgraded, any cards or upgrades will be lost once I make this hat!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
哦等等！在我们开始之前，请确认一件事。
如果你用来制作这顶针织帽的帽子经过强化，一旦我制作完成，所有的卡片和强化等级都将丢失！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
To be safe, I suggest you put everything not needed to make this hat into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
为了安全起见，我建议你将制作这顶帽子不需要的物品存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Ah! You brought everything already. Alright! How about I make you that Beanie right now?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
啊！你已经把所有东西都带来了。很好！那我现在就为你制作那顶针织帽？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Okay...
Dork. Come back When you decide to join the cool guys, word?
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
好吧...
笨蛋。等你想加入酷哥行列的时候再来找我，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Crunch Chew Chew Chew*^000000
^3355FF*Squish Squish Fwsht Fwsht*^000000
^3355FF*Crunch Crunch Tap Tap*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咔嚓 咀嚼 咀嚼 咀嚼*^000000
^3355FF*噗嗤 噗嗤 嘶嘶 嘶嘶*^000000
^3355FF*咔嚓 咔嚓 哒哒 哒哒*^000000

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
There you go! Your very own Beanie! Cute, but still 'dope!'
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
给你！这是属于你的针织帽！很可爱，但依然很酷！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Uh! Uh!
I'm in da house!
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
嘿！嘿！
我在这呢！

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
A Beanie!
Whether you plan to go to a house party, get your groove back, or be as fresh as a prince, you'll be chillin' with this fly style.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
针织帽！
无论你是打算去参加派对，找回节奏，还是像王子一样帅气，戴上这顶帽子你都会很酷。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
But well...
Although it can be a street fashion, Beanies also look really cute on some people.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
不过话说回来...
虽然针织帽可以是街头时尚，但在某些人头上看起来真的很可爱。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
Anyway, this is what I need to make a Beanie...
1 ^3355FFCap^000000 and
500 ^3355FFYarn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
总之，制作针织帽需要以下物品...
1 ^3355FF帽子^000000 和
500 ^3355FF毛线^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mad Hatter]
When you decide to represent yo' hood, come to me with the stuff. I'll hook you up.
scripts.translation:
[疯帽匠]
当你决定展示你的风格时，带着材料来找我。我会帮你搞定。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
等一下！
你身上携带的物品太多了。
请先将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
The Monster Museum has prepared a special event for your support~!
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
魔物博物馆为感谢您的支持，准备了特别活动~！

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Accessories typically worn by monsters are now available for adventurers to wear!
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
通常由魔物佩戴的饰品，现在也可以供冒险者佩戴了！

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Of course, since we're on a trial period, we can only provide 3 monster accessories to our fans. However, according to your response, we may add more monster accessories in the future.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
当然，由于目前处于试用阶段，我们只能向粉丝提供3件魔物饰品。不过，根据您的反馈，我们未来可能会增加更多魔物饰品。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Simply bring the required materials, and pay a small fee, and we will provide you with the monsters accessory of your choice.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
只需携带所需材料，并支付少量费用，我们就会为您提供您选择的魔物饰品。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Please choose the
accessory you are
interested in.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
请选择您感兴趣的饰品。

scripts.text: Decorative Golden Bell
scripts.translation: 巨大的金铃铛

scripts.text: Crown of Ancient Queen
scripts.translation: 古代女王的王冠

scripts.text: Crown of Mistress
scripts.translation: 蜂后的王冠

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
This Golden Bell is fashioned after the one worn by the 'Sohee' monster. It's a cute accessory I personally recommend for us ladies. A little oversized, but I believe you'll like it a lot.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
这个金铃铛是仿照“鬼女”魔物佩戴的铃铛制作的。这是一款可爱的饰品，我个人非常推荐给女士们。虽然有点大，但我相信您会很喜欢它的。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Thank you for
bringing everything.
Please wait one moment.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
感谢您带来了所有材料。
请稍等片刻。

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Clang Clang! Scrape Scrape! Jingle Jingle! *^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF* 叮当叮当！沙沙沙沙！叮铃叮铃！ *^000000

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Yoohoo~
There you go. Here's your beautiful Golden Bell. I doubt it will jingle if you shake your head, though.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
哟吼~
好了。这是您的宠物铃铛。不过我怀疑，即使您摇头，它也不会发出声音哦。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Oh, one more thing, don't confuse yourself with Sohee and commit suicide!
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
哦，还有一件事，别把自己和鬼女搞混了，然后当场死亡！

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
If you'd like me to make another one, please come again. Thank you for visiting the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
如果您想再做一个，请随时再来。感谢您光临博物馆。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
The required materials for the Decorative Golden Bell are...
^3355FF1 Golden Bell, 1 Emperium, 3 Gold^000000 and
20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
制作巨大的金铃铛所需的材料是...
^3355FF1个宠物铃铛，1个华丽金属，3个金块^000000
以及20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Just come ask me
when you're ready.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
准备好了随时来找我。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
This crown is inspired by the one worn by the 'Isis' monster. It has an elegant look fitting for ancient royalty.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
这顶王冠是仿照“蛇女伊丝”魔物佩戴的王冠制作的。它拥有符合古代王室身份的优雅外观。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Thank you for
bringing everything.
Please wait one moment.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
感谢您带来了所有材料。
请稍等片刻。

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Clang Clang! Scrape Scrape! Jingle Jingle! *^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF* 叮当叮当！沙沙沙沙！叮铃叮铃！ *^000000

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Tah dah!
Here's your Crown of Ancient Queen! I don't know if you can get anyone to bow before you while wearing this, but at least you'll look elegant.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
当当！
这是您的古代女王的王冠！我不知道戴着它能否让所有人向您鞠躬，但至少您会看起来非常优雅。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
If you'd like me to make another one, please come again. Thank you for visiting the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
如果您想再做一个，请随时再来。感谢您光临博物馆。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
The required materials for the Crown of Ancient Queen are...
^3355FF1 Queen's Hair Ornament, 1 Emperium, 3 Gold^000000 and
20,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
制作古代女王的王冠所需的材料是...
^3355FF1个蛇饰发箍，1个华丽金属，3个金块^000000
以及20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Just come ask me
when you're ready.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
准备好了随时来找我。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
This crown is an imitation of the one worn by the 'Mistress' monster. Wearing this will give you a look of brusque authority.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
这顶王冠是仿照“蜂后”魔物佩戴的王冠制作的。戴上它，您将展现出威严的气场。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Thank you for
bringing everything.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
感谢您带来了所有材料。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
^FF0000By the way, if you use an upgraded
Coronet for making this item,
the item you create out of the Coronet
will not have its upgraded status.^000000
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
^FF0000顺便说一下，如果您使用升级过的蛇饰发箍来制作此物品，
由蛇饰发箍制作出的物品将不会保留升级状态。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
^FF0000Also, please only have one Coronet in your inventory to make the Crown of Mistress. We are not responsible for any loss.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
^FF0000另外，制作蜂后的王冠时，请确保您的物品栏中只有一件王冠。我们不对任何丢失负责。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Are you sure you want to create the Crown of Mistress?
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
您确定要制作蜂后的王冠吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Wait a minute...!
scripts.translation: 等一下...

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Please wait one moment.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
请稍等片刻。

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Clang Clang! Scrape Scrape! Jingle Jingle! *^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF* 叮当叮当！沙沙沙沙！叮铃叮铃！ *^000000

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Yay! You've got a great looking crown!
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
耶！您有一顶非常漂亮的王冠！

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
I don't know if everyone will obey your commands while wearing this, but at least you can feel beautifully regal.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
我不知道戴着它时大家是否都会听从您的命令，但至少您可以感受到那种美丽的威严。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Why don't you go take a picture with Mistress? That would be funny to see if she wasn't too busy trying to maul you.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
您不妨去和蜂后合个影？如果她没忙着试图咬您的话，那画面一定很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
If you'd like me to make you another one, please come again. Thank you for visiting the Monster Museum.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
如果您想让我再为您制作一顶，欢迎随时再来。感谢您光临魔物博物馆。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
No problem, just be sure to understand our precautions well, okay?
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
没问题，不过请务必理解我们的注意事项，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
The required materials for the Crown of Mistress are...
^3355FF1 Coronet, 1 Emperium, 3 Gold^000000 and
40,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
制作蜂后的王冠所需的材料是...
^3355FF1个王冠、1个华丽金属、3个金币^000000
以及40,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Nehris]
Just come ask me
when you're ready.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[内里斯]
准备好了随时来找我。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Hmmm...
It's seems you're carrying too much stuff for me to give anything to you.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
嗯...
看来你携带的物品太多了，我没法把东西给你。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Talk to me again after you've freed up some of your inventory space by putting some of your things into the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
请先去卡普拉仓库存放一些物品，腾出背包空间后再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Oooh yeah!
Sometimes, even I can't believe how much this body of mine ripples with sexy love muscles~! I can barely hold them all in...
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
噢噢！

如果你找到更多的整人面具和指针，别忘了带给我！

[Muscle Man]
Hmmm...?
That's funny, I thought you would have that Mr. Scream mask and all those clock hands by now...
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
But...
Not everyone is fortunate to have a magnificent, flawless physique. There are people in this world that have tragically lost appendages in accidents.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
但是...
并非每个人都有幸拥有完美无瑕的健美身材。世界上有些人因为在事故中不幸失去了肢体，处境十分悲惨。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
When I realized this, I decided to help these people and began to research technology for artificial limbs. My studies have lead me to Alarms and their own mechanical limbs known as 'Ruimento.'
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
当我意识到这一点后，我决定帮助这些人，并开始研究假肢技术。我的研究让我关注到了钟怪以及它们拥有的被称为“Ruimento”的机械肢体。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
The Alarms, and their 'Ruimento,' are made from an ancient mysterious technology. You can only find these in the Clock Tower.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
钟怪及其“Ruimento”是由一种古老的神秘技术制造的。你只能在中央塔找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
So I am trying to research a method to reproduce Ruimetto, except in a smaller form for the human body. If I'm successful, it would be a medical miracle!
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
所以我正在研究一种方法来复制Ruimento，只是将其缩小以适应人体。如果成功，那将是一个医学奇迹！

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
However, I need help in completing my research. Hence, the reason I've told you my story, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
然而，我需要帮助来完成我的研究。这就是我向你讲述我故事的原因，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
I desperately need materials to continuing testing so that I can develop a prototype. I'll need ^0000FFClock Hand^000000 from Alarms and ^0000FFMr. Scream^000000 in order to continue my research.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
我急需材料来继续测试，以便开发原型。我需要来自钟怪的^0000FF指针^000000和^0000FF整人面具^000000才能继续我的研究。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]

scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
我本来可以自己去收集这些东西，但每次我登上中央塔，我都无法忍心破坏钟怪，只是惊叹于它们那机械而阳刚的身材。

scripts.text:

如果你能帮我的忙，我保证会给你，呃...

scripts.text:

...this Alarm Mask!
.....
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
...这个钟怪假面！
.....

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
I'd wear it myself, if it weren't for the fact that people never look at my face anyway. Everyone I meet seems to be fixated on my chiseled form. But trust me, this mask is pretty cool.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
如果不是因为人们从来不看我的脸，我肯定会自己戴上的。我遇到的每个人似乎都只盯着我雕刻般的身材。但相信我，这个面具真的很酷。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Please adventurer...
Help me give muscles to the world.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
拜托了，冒险者...
帮我向全世界传播肌肉的力量吧。

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Oh~~! You know how I feel about Alarm's beautiful mechanic muscle! I am glad to have met someone who shares my good sense of taste.
scripts.translation:
[肌肉男]
哦~~！你知道我对钟怪那美丽的机械肌肉有多着迷吗？很高兴能遇到和我品味相投的人。

scripts.text:
[Muscle Man]
Okay, here's the deal.
Bring me...
^0000FF3000 Clock Hand^000000 and
^0000FF1 Mr. Scream^000000.

[Muscle Man]
With those, I will be able to continue my research, at least for a while. As I told you, I will give you this awesome ^0000FFAlarm Mask^000000 for those items!
scripts.translation:

有了这些，我就能继续我的研究了，至少能维持一段时间。正如我所说的，我会用这些物品交换给你这个超棒的^0000FF钟怪假面^000000！

scripts.text:

Now! Go for it!
Let's spread our love for muscle around the globe!
scripts.translation:

现在！去吧！
让我们把对肌肉的热爱传遍全球！

Oh~! I'm sorry!!

scripts.translation:

哦~！对不起！！

scripts.text:

I forget how breathtaking the sheer majesty of my body can be. It's alright, take your time, savor the visual pleasure...
scripts.translation:

我忘了我身体的宏伟壮观是多么令人惊叹。没关系，慢慢欣赏，享受这视觉盛宴...

如果你给我镶嵌了卡片或升级过的装备，^ff0000那些物品中的升级属性和卡片在我制作东西后会丢失。^000000所以，请留意这一点。

好了。*呼~*
这是你的“懒洋洋的猫”帽子，基于科学原理制作！另外，介意我留下那根沙漠之狼指甲吗？嘿嘿，谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Why don't I make you...
a 'Drooping Cat?'
Having a cat for a hat makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out...
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
我为什么不给你做一顶...
“懒洋洋的猫”呢？
只要听我解释，你就会明白用猫做帽子是有某种道理的...

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
At the Juno Library, I read in this issue of 'Funtime Kid Science' that all cats, whether they're wild or domesticated, are hunters that have mastered the art of saving their energy.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
在朱诺图书馆，我在《儿童趣味科学》的一期杂志上读到，所有的猫，无论是野生的还是家养的，都是精通节省能量艺术的猎人。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
After investing many hours napping in the sun, they've developed the perfect position to nap in any place and in any condition: the lazy feline droop.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
在享受了数小时的阳光小睡之后，它们发展出了在任何地方、任何条件下都能完美小睡的姿势：慵懒的猫式垂头。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
It's impossible for humans to even imitate this special feline skill without the inspiration from this hat!
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
如果没有这顶帽子的灵感，人类甚至无法模仿这种特殊的猫科技能！

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
And even if you don't manage to copy the napping cat droop, at least this'll keep the sun off the top of your head, if not out of your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
即使你没能复制出那种慵懒的猫式垂头，至少这顶帽子能挡住头顶的阳光，即使不能完全遮住眼睛。

[Lee Hester]
I know, I know, wearing a big ol' Leaf on top of your head sounds impractical. But, it makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out.

我知道，我知道，在头上戴一片大叶子听起来很不实用。但如果你听我解释一下，这其实是有某种道理的。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Do you ever notice how on a hot day, you feel a lot cooler when you wear white, but you're a lot warmer when you wear black?
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
你有没有注意到，在炎热的日子里，穿白色衣服会觉得凉快很多，而穿黑色衣服则会觉得热很多？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
After some intense thinking, and reading some 'Funtime Kid Science' magazines in Juno, I realized that the color black absorbs sunlight and heat, and that the color white reflects it.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
经过一番深思熟虑，并在朱诺阅读了一些《趣味儿童科学》杂志后，我意识到黑色会吸收阳光和热量，而白色则会反射它们。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So...
What happens if you're wearing no colors? If my ^333333*ahem*^000000 hypothesis is correct, you wouldn't feel any heat if you were invisible!
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
那么...
如果你不穿任何颜色呢？如果我的^333333*咳咳*^000000假设是正确的，当你隐形时，你就不会感觉到任何热量！

scripts.text:

That's why I've created this Racoon Leaf, in an attempt to imitate Smokie's uncanny invisibility powers.
scripts.translation:

这就是我制作这片“变身叶子”的原因，试图模仿狸猫那不可思议的隐形能力。

It...

scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
它...
我还没能让它完全按我想要的样子工作。但它是一片大叶子！它能提供一些阴凉。

为什么我不做...

我知道，我知道，头上顶着一只狸猫听起来很荒谬，但如果你听我解释一下，这其实是有某种道理的。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So I learned from an issue of 'Funtime Kid Science' at Juno Library that different colors absorb or reflect sunlight.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
所以我在朱诺图书馆的一本《趣味儿童科学》杂志上了解到，不同的颜色会吸收或反射阳光。

scripts.text:

Wearing one color makes you feel warmer, and another makes you feel cooler on a hot day.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
在炎热的日子里，穿一种颜色会让你感觉更热，而另一种颜色会让你感觉更凉快。

[Lee Hester]
So I was thinking...
What if I had no colors?
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
所以我在想...
如果我没有任何颜色呢？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
And, as we all know, you wear no colors if you're invisible, or when you're completely nude. I've already conducted my nudity experiment with sad and pitiable results...
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
而且，众所周知，如果你隐形了，或者完全裸体，你就没有任何颜色。我已经做过裸体实验，结果令人悲伤且可怜...

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So now I'm experimenting with invisibility. I've tried using a human sized Smokie Leaf to become invisible, but it didn't really work yet. So I got to thinking...
scripts.translation:

所以我现在正在研究隐形。我试过用一张人类尺寸的狸猫树叶来让自己隐形，但效果并不理想。于是我开始思考...
