scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
如果我把一只狸猫和我连接起来，当它隐形时，我是不是也会隐形？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I haven't been able to try it yet, because Smokies are pretty heavy and I've got to build up my neck muscles before I can strap a Smokie to my head.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
我还没法尝试，因为狸猫挺重的，我得先锻炼颈部肌肉，才能把狸猫绑在头上。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So of course I need a practice Smokie to wear on my head before I'm ready for the real thing.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
所以，在准备好真正的狸猫之前，我当然需要一只练习用的狸猫戴在头上。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
And that was how I invented the 'Lazy Smokie' hat.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
就这样，我发明了“讨厌的狸猫”帽子。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
The items I need are...
1000 ^ff0000Acorn^000000,
100 ^ff0000Sea-Otter Fur^000000 and
10 ^ff0000Raccoon Leaf^000000.

[Lee Hester]
Ah...
You brought everything.
Excellent! Okay, give me some time to create the 'Blue Fish' hat out of all this fish.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
啊...
你全都带来了。
太好了！请给我一点时间，用这些鱼制作“蓝色鱼”帽子。

scripts.text: *Scratch scratch...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*

*Scratch scratch...*
*Tap tap...*
*Scratch scratch...*

^3355FFHmm...
Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嗯...
这听起来不像是制作帽子的声音...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
哦，别担心。快完成了。

scripts.text: *Swish swish...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*

*Swish swish...*
*Chomp chomp...*
*Wataaaaa~!*

[Lee Hester]
There you go. *Phew~*
Your own 'Blue Fish' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
好了。*呼~*
这是属于你的“蓝色鱼”帽子，基于科学原理制作！另外，介意我留下那根沙漠之狼指甲吗？嘿嘿，谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Ah! I got it!
How about I make you...
a 'Blue Fish' hat?
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
啊！我想到了！
不如我为你制作...
一顶“蓝色鱼”帽子？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I know putting a Fish on top of your head doesn't sound like the best idea, but it makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
我知道，头上顶着一只鱼听起来不是个好主意，但如果你听我解释一下，这其实是有某种道理的。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
So I was reading some issues of 'Funtime Kid Science' at the Juno Library, and read about animals that take naps under the sun when they feel really hot.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
所以我在朱诺图书馆读了几期《趣味儿童科学》杂志，了解到有些动物在感觉特别热的时候会在阳光下打盹。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
 So then I thought...
Animals that don't take naps under the sun must never feel hot?
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
于是我想...
那些不在阳光下打盹的动物，一定从不觉得热吧？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I decided to make a hat of that one perfect beast that was immune to the sun, never having to succumb its power.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
我决定用那只完美免疫阳光、从未屈服于其力量的神兽来做一顶帽子。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I set to work immediately, listing all the animals I know that don't take naps in the sun. Then, I removed any animals from the list that I didn't like, especially the ones with really long names.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
我立刻开始工作，列出了所有我知道的不在阳光下打盹的动物。然后，我把我不喜欢的动物从列表中删掉了，尤其是那些名字特别长的。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Finally, I had only three creatures on my list: the Emu, the Giraffe and the Fish.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
最后，我的列表上只剩下三种生物：鸸鹋、长颈鹿和鱼。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
First, I removed Emu, because everyone kept telling me I was spelling it wrong. And as everyone knows, a Giraffe hat would just look ridiculous. So, of course, I chose the Fish.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
首先，我删掉了鸸鹋，因为大家一直说我拼写错了。而且众所周知，长颈鹿帽子看起来会很荒谬。所以，我当然选择了鱼。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
And that, my friend, was how I invented the 'Blue Fish' hat.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
就这样，我的朋友，我发明了“蓝色鱼”帽子。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
The items I need are...
^ff00001 Rotten Fish,
300 Stinky Scale,
50 Sushi,
1 Fish Tail^000000 and
^ff0000100 Sticky Mucus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
我需要的材料是...
^ff00001 腐臭之鱼，
300 腐烂鳞片，
50 明虾寿司，
1 鱼尾^000000 和
^ff0000100 粘稠液体^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Oh... I see.
I'm a little disappointed, but you probably already have a nice hat to keep the sun out of your eyes. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be here.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
哦...我明白了。
我有点失望，但你大概已经有一顶不错的帽子来遮挡阳光了。好吧，如果你改变主意，我会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Isn't it such
a beautiful day
today?
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
今天天气真美啊，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Beautiful...
But insanely hot.
I live here, I should know. Still, nothing can beat the Morocc sunset.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
很美...
但热得让人发疯。
我住在这里，我当然知道。不过，没有什么能比得上莫洛克的日落。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
It's amazing how so many different animals can live in the desert. I've been spending some time researching the ways of animals, reading books in the Juno Library...
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
真令人惊叹，沙漠里竟然能生存这么多不同的动物。我花了一些时间研究动物的习性，在朱诺图书馆里读了不少书...

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
Trying to figure out the Animal Kingdom's secrets of dealing with the heat.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
试图弄清楚动物王国应对高温的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Lee Hester]
I hope you're having a good time here in Morocc. If you ever question the special abilities of animals, just think of the majestic Desert Wolf that's able to thrive in the harsh Morocc deserts.
scripts.translation:
[李·海丝特]
我希望你在莫洛克玩得开心。如果你怀疑动物的特殊能力，想想那只在严酷的莫洛克沙漠中繁衍生息的雄伟沙漠之狼吧。

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Yelp! Yelp yelp!
Yelp! Yelp yelp!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
嗷！嗷嗷！
嗷！嗷嗷！

scripts.text: Shake head
scripts.translation: 摇头

scripts.text: Nod head
scripts.translation: 点头

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Yelp! Yelp yelp!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
嗷！嗷嗷！

scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您目前携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库后 -
- 再回来。 -

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Oh! You finally brought what I've asked, human. Okay, now I can bring her back to life!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
哦！你终于带来了我要的东西，人类。好了，现在我可以让她复活了！

scripts.text: Give items
scripts.translation: 交出物品

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Now...
Take this
and get out
of my sight~!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
现在...
拿着这个
然后从我的视线里消失~！

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
......Errr?
Now why am I in human form again?
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
......呃？
为什么我又变回人形了？

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
I guess... I need to practice transformation more often. *Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我想...我需要更经常练习变身。*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
Anyway, I've got a bone to pick with you humans. You're an aggressive and greedy race, always killing things and taking stuff. And despite all the hunting, you never seem to be satisfied.
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
总之，我有一笔账要和你们人类算。你们是个好斗且贪婪的种族，总是杀戮并夺取东西。尽管猎杀了这么多，你们似乎永远都不满足。

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
You always intrude our territory to slay us foxes for our nice, soft fur. But it's not only us you harass. The Sohees always complain that you barbaric humans keep stealing their clothing!
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
你们总是侵入我们的领地，猎杀我们狐狸以获取我们柔软漂亮的皮毛。但你们骚扰的不仅仅是我们。鬼女们总是抱怨你们这些野蛮的人类不断偷窃她们的衣服！

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
My wife was killed as a victim of human greed, probably skinned for her fabulous pelt...
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我的妻子成为了人类贪婪的受害者，大概是因为她那华丽的皮毛而被剥皮...

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
All I want is to bring her back to life, no matter what the cost. That's why I'm swallowing my pride and asking you for help.
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我只想让她的复活，不惜一切代价。这就是我放下尊严，向你求助的原因。

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
I need...
^0000FF999^000000 ^FF0000Nine Tail^000000
in order to cast the Fox Resurrection spell.
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我需要...
^0000FF999^000000 ^FF0000九尾狐^000000
才能施展狐族复活术。

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
I know how you humans think...
You want some sort of reward for whatever mayhem you cause. Alright then...
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
我知道你们人类是怎么想的...
你们总是想为造成的破坏索取某种报酬。好吧...

scripts.text:
[Nine Tails]
I will give you this ^0000FFKitsune Mask^000000 if you bring me what I asked. How does that sound? Remember, ^0000FF999 ^FF0000Nine Tail^000000.
scripts.translation:
[九尾狐]
如果你能给我我想要的东西，我就把这个^0000FF狐狸假面^000000给你。怎么样？记住，^0000FF999 ^FF0000九尾狐^000000。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您现在携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
.......
.........
Human, what are you doing in my home?!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
......
........
人类，你在我家里干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hurrumph.
I guess you decided to come inside, thinking no one was around, to rest after killing others of my kind.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
哼。
看来你是以为没人，才进来休息的，杀了我们这么多同类之后。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Well! We Orcs are a proud race!
So don't expect me to talk to you.
Though, I must admit that you have courage to enter an Orc's home.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
听着！我们兽人是骄傲的种族！
所以别指望我会跟你说话。
不过，我不得不承认，你有勇气进入兽人的家。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I'm too tired to kill you today, but keep silent! If you're wounded, you can bleed quietly on the floor and die with some honor I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我今天太累了，不想杀你，但给我闭嘴！如果你受了伤，就安静地在地板上流血，带着一点尊严死去吧。

scripts.text: Come on, let's talk.
scripts.translation: 来吧，我们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You dare invite an Orc to conversation?! We Orcs are a savage race! Born out suffering, we only live to fight and do battle!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你竟敢邀请一个兽人交谈？！我们兽人是野蛮的种族！在苦难中出生，我们只为战斗和厮杀而活！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Talk with humans?!
Hah! The only way I will suffer such humiliation would be if you too, lost your dignity.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
跟人类说话？！
哈！唯一让我忍受这种屈辱的方式，就是你也失去了你的尊严。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You can bleed in my house, but I will only talk with you if...
You bring ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你可以在我的房子里流血，但我只会在...你带来^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000的情况下才跟你说话！

scripts.text: I challenge you to a duel, Orc!
scripts.translation: 我向你发起决斗，兽人！

scripts.text: 1000 Jellopies it is.
scripts.translation: 那就1000个杰勒比结晶。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Humans... such annoying bastards!
If you want to fight, go outside!
So get out of my house!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
人类...真是一群讨厌的家伙！
如果你想打架，就出去！
所以滚出我的房子！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hah! It's a promise then!
Bwahahahahhahahahahahaha!
That's 1000 Jellopies!
Are all you humans so foolish?!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
哈！那就说定了！
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
那是1000个杰勒比结晶！
你们人类都这么愚蠢吗？！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
WHAT?!
That's so much Jellopy!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
什么？！
那是那么多杰勒比结晶！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I do not like this joke you have played on me human. Still, I refuse to believe that you have really brought ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我不喜欢你对我开的这个玩笑，人类。不过，我拒绝相信你真的带来了^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We Orcs are a proud race and do not like to admit when we are wrong.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我们兽人是骄傲的种族，不喜欢承认自己错了。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
One...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
一...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
One... T-two...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
一...二...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
One... T-two...
Three...

[Orc Warrior]
One... T-two...
Three...
....F-f-fooooour...

[Orc Warrior]
.......

[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-eight...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
九百九十八...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-eight...
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
九百九十八...
九百九十九...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-eight...
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
One...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
九百九十八...
九百九十九...
一...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-eight...
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
One... One thousand.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
九百九十八...
九百九十九...
一...一千。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Curse you, human.
You have shall your 'conversation.'
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
该死的人类。
你居然敢跟我“对话”。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I hate humans! In fact, all Orcs hate humans! Hate you hate you hate you with a passion!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我讨厌人类！事实上，所有兽人都讨厌人类！我恨你，恨你，恨你入骨！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
So...
Still in the mood to talk?!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那么...
你还想继续聊吗？！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Tough!
If you want to
hear more, bring...
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
真硬气！
如果你想听更多，就带来...
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now get out of here, you horrible stinking, poor excuse for an animal!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在滚出这里，你这臭烘烘、低劣的畜生！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?!
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你忘了吗？！
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000！
如果你想对话，就拿出你的诚意。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
No.... Not again!!
What are you doing with so much Jellopy?!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
不...不要再来了！！
你带这么多杰勒比结晶干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Damn...!
I refuse to speak to you until I've finished counting all of this Jellopy.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
该死...
在我数完这些杰勒比结晶之前，我拒绝和你说话。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...
.....

[Orc Warrior]
...
.....
ONE THOUSAND.

[Orc Warrior]
Once again, human, you've managed to infuriate me. But we Orcs are a proud race. I shall fulfill my part of this pathetic deal.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
人类，你又一次成功激怒了我。但我们兽人是骄傲的种族。我会履行这份可笑协议中的义务。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, where was I?
Oh right.
How much I hate humans.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在，我刚才说到哪了？
哦，对了。
我有多讨厌人类。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Humans are always invading our village, intruding on our land! They kill our warriors not out of honor, but for selfish human reasons!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
人类总是入侵我们的村庄，践踏我们的土地！他们杀害我们的战士，不是为了荣誉，而是为了人类自私的理由！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Bah! Humans have built their own towns and cities. Do they keep their senseless killing amongst each other?! NO! Humans have to rampage and ravage everything!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
哼！人类建立了自己的城镇和城市。难道他们只在彼此之间进行无意义的杀戮吗？！不！人类必须四处肆虐，破坏一切！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, if you want
to listen to more,
bring me...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在，如果你想继续听下去，就给我带...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000 again!
I do not think that you can endure much more of this torture.
Bwahahahahahha~!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000！
我想你大概受不了这种折磨了。
哇哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget!?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你这么快就忘了吗！？
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000！
如果你想说话，就表现出你的尊重。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
.....
Again, human, you confound me with your stubborness. I see that humans are masochists. Or just like to annoy Orcs by making them count a thousand Jellopies.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
.....
人类啊，你的固执真是让我困惑。看来人类都是受虐狂。或者就是喜欢让人类数一千个杰勒比结晶来惹怒兽人。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
*sigh* Let me count...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
*叹气* 让我数数...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...
.......

[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
九百九十九...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nine hundred ninety-nine...
...A thousand.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
九百九十九...
...一千。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Argh~!
Now where was I?
Oh right, why humans are scum.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
啊~！
现在，我刚才说到哪了？
哦，对了，为什么人类是垃圾。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
How dare humans think they're so great?! We Orcs have also made contributions to the world!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
人类怎么敢觉得自己那么伟大？！我们兽人也对世界做出了贡献！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Humans may have built cities and towns, but we Orcs have also created our own cave complexes and canals!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
人类也许建立了城市，但我们兽人也创造了我们自己的洞穴群和运河！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We Orcs have invented many useful things! Of course, now we've had to keep these things to ourselves. Why? Because of the stupidity and greed of humans!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我们兽人发明了许多有用的东西！当然，现在我们不得不把这些东西藏起来。为什么？因为人类的愚蠢和贪婪！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We Orcs have once constructed a tower for a human, but were then trapped and enslaved there. Needless to say, humans are deserving of our wrath and fury.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我们兽人曾经为人类建造了一座塔，但随后被困在那里并被奴役。不用说，人类理应受到我们的愤怒和怒火。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
*Sigh*
I don't understand why I am sharing this story about my tribe.
That's enough for today!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
*叹气*
我不明白我为什么要分享关于我部落的故事。
今天就到这里吧！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Grrr~! If you want to listen longer go bring me ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000 again.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
咕噜~！如果你想听更久，就再给我带^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget!?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect if
you wish to talk!!
I don't take the 2,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你这么快就忘了吗！？
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000！
如果你想说话，就表现出你的尊重！！
我不把你给我的2000个杰勒比结晶当回事！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Oh... it's you again.
I can see the Jellopy in your hands, and I'm pretty sure you've brought a thousand again, so let's get this over with.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
哦...又是你。
我看到你手里的杰勒比结晶，我相当确定你又带来了一千个，所以让我们快点结束吧。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
*Sigh* I suppose it's time for our conversation.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
*叹气* 我想，是时候开始我们的对话了。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Once upon a time, Orcs and humans were allies. I... I miss those times. But it's no use to long for old comraderies. It's impossible to clear up such misunderstandings from ages ago...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
很久以前，兽人和人类曾是盟友。我...我怀念那段时光。但怀念旧日的友谊已无济于事。要消除那些年代久远的误解...是不可能的...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
There are too many wicked humans that have pursued wealth and fame at any cost. They don't understand ideals like honor and loyalty, and use any means to get whatever they want.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
有太多邪恶的人类，为了财富和名声不择手段。他们不懂荣誉和忠诚这样的理想，为了得到想要的东西，什么手段都使得出来。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Those hateful humans started to get rid of every obstacle that stood between them and what they wanted, not caring if friend or foe stood in their way.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那些令人憎恨的人类开始清除挡在他们和欲望之间的一切障碍，无论是朋友还是敌人，只要挡路就毫不留情。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
...I've talked too much already.
That's the end of the conversation for today.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
...我话说得太多了。
今天的对话就到这里吧。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, if you want to listen some more, go bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000 again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在，如果你想继续听，明天再给我带
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 3,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你这么快就忘了吗？
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000！
如果你想说话，就表现出你的尊重。
我不把你给我的3000个杰勒比结晶当回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
*Sigh...*
You're too tough to get rid of.
Do you really want to listen to me so much...?
Okay... I will tell you a little bit more then.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
*叹气...*
你真是难缠。
你真的这么想听我说话吗...？
好吧...那我就再多说一点。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
For us Orcs, victory in battle is the greatest honor.
We fight boldly and fearlessly with our opponent, giving our all in hopes of a fair victory. We would die for victory in battle.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
对我们兽人来说，战斗中的胜利是最大的荣耀。
我们勇敢地、无畏地与对手搏斗，全力以赴，渴望公平的胜利。为了战斗中的胜利，我们甘愿赴死。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Even after death, we never lose the spirit of combat. It is said that some Orcs that have died unfairly will stand from their graves to seek even more battle.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
即使死后，我们也从未失去战斗的精神。据说，有些死得不公平的兽人会从坟墓中站起来，寻求更多的战斗。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The difference between you humans and us is that we would never tolerate foul play in battle. But more importantly, Orcs never, ever retreat. An Orc will always fight till the last breath...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你们人类和我们的区别在于，我们绝不容忍战斗中的卑鄙手段。但更重要的是，兽人绝不撤退。兽人会战斗到最后一口气...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Orcs never restore health during battle using your silly medicines. Hmpf. Humans can be so weak, drinking bottles of Potion to keep up in a fight. Oh well, though, I'm not sure if you're the same.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
兽人从不在战斗中用你们那些愚蠢的药水来恢复体力。哼。人类真脆弱，为了在战斗中撑下去，还得喝一瓶瓶的药水。不过，我也不确定你是不是也一样。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, if you want
to listen to me
some more, go and
bring me ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在，如果你想
继续听我说话，
明天去给我带
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 4,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你这么快就忘了吗？
^FF00001000个杰勒比结晶^000000！
如果你想说话，就表现出你的尊重。
我不把你给我的4000个杰勒比结晶当回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
What the...! Don't you know when to stop? I do not believe a human would like to hear about Orcs so much. But...
We Orcs are a proud race, and I shall oblige.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
该死的...！你不知道适可而止吗？我不相信会有人类这么想听关于兽人的事。但是...
我们兽人是一个骄傲的种族，我会满足你的要求。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We only select the strongest of our tribe to become warriors. When Orcs reach adulthood, they are sent to the forest to survive alone in its environment.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我们只挑选部落中最强壮的个体成为战士。当兽人成年后，它们会被送入森林，独自在那里生存。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Those Orcs that come back alive are recognized as true members of the tribe. The strongest males are chosen to become Orc Warriors, and the strongest females are chosen as Orc Ladies.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那些活着回来的兽人会被承认为部落的真正成员。最强的雄性会被选为兽人战士，最强的雌性会被选为兽人女士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Orcs that have proven to have good sight and dexterity are given bows and arrows and become Orc Archers.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那些被证明拥有良好视力和敏捷性的兽人，会被授予弓箭，成为兽人弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We Orcs have a special training course called 'The Trial of Fire.' If any Orc Warrior passes this course, he will be protected by our fire god...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我们兽人有一项特殊的训练课程，叫做“火之试炼”。如果任何兽人战士通过了这项课程，他将受到我们火神的庇护...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
That Orc will have stronger physical strength and abilities than normal Orc Warriors. These warriors are known as High Orcs.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那个兽人将拥有比普通兽人战士更强的体力和能力。这些战士被称为兽人战士长。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm, well to you humans, we may all look the same, but we Orcs can tell each other apart. How about you, human? Do I look the same as every Warrior outside to you?
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
嗯，在你们人类眼里，我们可能都长得差不多，但我们兽人之间能互相分辨。那么你呢，人类？在我眼里，外面的每一个战士看起来都一样吗？

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
If you want to
listen longer,
go bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
好了...
如果你想继续听，
明天再来给我
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 5,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你忘了吗？
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000！
想跟我说话就拿出点诚意来。
我可没把你给我的那5000个杰勒比结晶当回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I expected you to quit by now. But I was wrong, because you're here once again. We made a deal and I will keep my promise.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我以为你早就放弃了。但我错了，因为你又来了。我们既然达成了约定，我就会信守承诺。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Last time, we were
talking about our
warriors...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
上次，我们聊到了
我们的战士...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Sometimes, a few Orcs are born among us, possessing phenomenal strength and talent. It is rumored that they could compete with 10,000 warriors at a time...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
有时候，我们中间会诞生一些拥有非凡力量和天赋的兽人。据说他们能同时对抗一万名战士...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
They are the best warriors of the Orc tribe, and are known to you as Orc Heroes. Not only are they the strongest ones among us, but they also our leaders in battle.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
他们是兽人部落中最强的战士，也就是你们所说的兽人英雄。他们不仅是我们中最强的，也是我们在战场上的领袖。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
As proof of their status, Orc Heroes are given Vouchers of Orcish Hero, as well as special swords that are only allowed to be used by our heroes.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
作为地位的象征，兽人英雄会被授予兽人英雄凭证，以及只有我们英雄才能使用的特别的剑。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
That sword can tear the sky, sever the earth and make a waterfall flow backwards.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那把剑能撕裂天空，斩断大地，甚至能让瀑布倒流。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The special helmet that is only worn by Orc Heroes represents the power and honor of the Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
只有兽人英雄才能佩戴的特殊头盔，象征着兽人战士的力量与荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Well, humans rarely get the chance to see this helmet unless they're in battle with an Orc Hero themselves...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
嗯，人类很少有机会看到这顶头盔，除非他们亲自与兽人英雄交战...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, if you want
to listen longer,
go and bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
好了，如果你想
继续听，
明天再来给我
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你忘了吗？
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000！
想跟我说话就拿出点诚意来。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I don't take the 6,000 jellopies you have given to me that seriously.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我可没把你给我的那6000个杰勒比结晶当回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Oh, hello. You're back.
Go ahead and put the 1000 Jellopies over there on the table by the skulls.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
哦，你好。你回来了。
把那1000个杰勒比结晶放到那边骷髅旁边的桌子上吧。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Ah yes, we were talking about Orc Heroes. Now, unlike Orc Heroes who are blessed with might from the day they were born, there are older, seasoned warriors that have managed to survive many years of combat.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
啊对，我们刚才聊到了兽人英雄。不过，与那些天生拥有神力的兽人英雄不同，还有一些年长且经验丰富的战士，他们在多年的战斗中幸存了下来。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
To Orc Warriors, we do not see age as weakness. We look up to old warriors as our trainers due to their experience in battle and their fighting skills.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
对于兽人战士来说，我们并不认为年龄意味着衰弱。我们尊敬老战士，视他们为导师，因为他们拥有丰富的战斗经验和精湛的武艺。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Those old warriors have shown outstanding fighting abilities, even without the use of weapons.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
这些老战士展现了卓越的战斗力，即使不使用武器也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
They could endure in battle for at least few days without axes. When you get to a certain fighting skill level, weapons can actually become a burden...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
他们能在没有战斧的情况下，在战斗中坚持好几天。当武艺达到一定境界时，武器反而会成为负担...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Among those well-experienced warriors, the greatest one of all is given the title of Orc Lord, and is given our respect as the leader of our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
在这些经验丰富的战士中，最伟大的一位会被授予兽人酋长的头衔，并受到我们作为部落首领的尊敬。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Every Orc can recognize him by his distinguished helm with the three horns.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
每个兽人都能通过他头上那顶长着三只角的独特头盔认出他。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
If you want to
listen longer,
go bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
好了...
如果你想继续听，
明天再来给我
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 7,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你忘了吗？
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000！
如果你想说话，就表现出你的敬意。
你给我的7000个杰勒比结晶，我可没当回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
It's been a while I've seen such a determined human such as yourself. Just leave the Jellopy near the bed.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
好久没见过像你这样意志坚定的人类了。把杰勒比结晶放在床边就好。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
Let me tell you
more about the
Orc Tribe.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那么...
让我再告诉你
一些关于
兽人部落的事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although I don't like to admit it, there are cowardly Orcs that run away from battle, or fight using dishonorable methods.
Needless to say, they have brought shame and disgrace to our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
虽然我不愿承认，但确实有一些懦弱的兽人，他们会在战斗中逃跑，或者使用卑鄙的手段。
不用说，他们给部落带来了耻辱和污名。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
A curse is placed on those dishonorable Orcs so that they can be singled out by the tribe and banished from the village.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那些不光彩的兽人会被施加诅咒，以便被部落识别出来，并驱逐出村庄。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You may recognize those cursed Orcs by their shrunken bodies and long teeth.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你可以通过他们萎缩的身体和长长的牙齿认出那些被诅咒的兽人。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
We call these cursed Orcs Zenorc. They are forced to live inside of caves or dungeons, away from from honorable Orcs. It's difficult to believe that Zenorcs were once one of us...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我们称这些被诅咒的兽人为兹诺克。他们被迫生活在洞穴或地下城深处，远离光荣的兽人。很难相信兹诺克曾经也是我们的族人...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I don't think there is a curse which transforms humans into a totally ugly creature depending on their deeds. So it is difficult to tell which humans are honorable...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我不认为存在一种诅咒，会根据人类的行为将他们变成丑陋的生物。所以很难分辨哪些人类是光荣的...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
If you want
to hear more,
go bring me
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000
again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那么...
如果你想
听更多，
明天再来给我
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take the 8,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你忘了吗？
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000！
如果你想说话，就表现出你的敬意。
你给我的8000个杰勒比结晶，我可没当回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
With these...
You have brought me 10,000 Jellopies. I must say that I am impressed. Since you have shown me your respect, I will repay you with my honesty.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
有了这些...
你一共给了我10000个杰勒比结晶。我必须说，我很受感动。既然你向我展示了敬意，我也会以诚实回报你。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Considering the stories about my tribe, it's enough for me if you just listen. However, merely listening is totally different from having the experience as your own.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
考虑到关于我部落的故事，只要你肯听就足够了。然而，仅仅倾听与亲身经历是完全不同的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I suggest you that you experience more battles with the many different Orcs out there. That's the best way of understanding and learning about the Orc tribe.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我建议你多去和外面各种各样的兽人战斗。这是了解和认识兽人部落的最好方式。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
This is a small token of my gratitue. This axe used to aid me in many battles and is very precious to me. I hope you will take care of this.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
这是我的一点小小谢意。这把斧头曾帮助我在许多战斗中获胜，对我来说非常珍贵。希望你能好好保管它。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You have made a lot of effort to show me respect, despite being a human. Now, if you want to learn more about Orcs, feel free to come back anytime, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
作为一个人类，你付出了很多努力来向我表示敬意。现在，如果你想了解更多关于兽人的事，随时欢迎回来，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Did you already forget?
^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000!
Show me your respect
if you want to talk.
I don't take 9,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你忘了吗？
^FF00001000 杰勒比结晶^000000！
如果你想说话，就表现出你的敬意。
你给我的9000个杰勒比结晶，我可没当回事。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You have made a lot of effort to show me your respect. Now, if you want to learn more about Orcs, feel free to come back anytime, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你付出了很多努力来向我表示敬意。现在，如果你想了解更多关于兽人的事，随时欢迎回来，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Oh, I see you've taken my advice and have been meeting many other Orcs through battle.
You must have learned much about the Orc's spirit of battle by seeing it for yourself firsthand.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
哦，看来你听从了我的建议，通过战斗结识了许多其他兽人。
亲眼见证这一切，你一定对兽人的战斗精神有了深刻的了解。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
These Orchish Vouchers you have been collecting are the true token of Orc warriors. We recognize an Orc who won over 1,000 battles as a true Orc Warrior.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你收集的这些兽人凭证，是真正的兽人战士的象征。我们承认赢得1000场战斗的兽人为真正的兽人战士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Still...
You're a human, so I don't give we can give you that honor so easily...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
不过...
你是人类，所以我不能轻易给你这份荣誉...

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Alright...
Go win over 10,000 battles.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
好吧...
去赢得10000场战斗吧。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Then, I'm sure you can be granted status as a real Orc warrior. But, make sure you are fighting for honorable purposes, and that you have no other motive.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那样，我相信你就能获得真正的兽人战士的地位。但是，请确保你是为了荣誉而战，没有其他目的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You only achieve honor by winning battles. Even among Orcs, I'm sure you can prove your battle prowess by defeating 10,000 Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
只有通过赢得战斗才能获得荣誉。即使是在兽人中，我相信你也能通过击败10000名兽人战士来证明你的战斗实力。

scripts.text: I don't think that is necessary.
scripts.translation: 我觉得没有必要。

scripts.text: I will win 10,000 battles!
scripts.translation: 我会赢得10000场战斗！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I see. I will not force you to choose what I wish to see you do. I respect your decision.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我明白了。我不会强迫你选择我希望你做的事。我尊重你的决定。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although...
I wished for other Orcs to see and understand that not all humans are wicked and selfish.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
虽然...
我希望其他兽人能看到并理解，并非所有人类都是邪恶和自私的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Ah, spoken like a true warrior. Alright then, go forth and do battle with others of my tribe, and bring me 10,000 Orcish Vouchers.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
啊，像个真正的战士一样说话。好吧，那就去吧，与我部落的其他人战斗，并给我带来10000个兽人战士之证。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I took 100 Orcish Voucher from you now. Now, fight and fight until you have defeated 10,000 more Orc Warriors so that the whole tribe will have to recognize you!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我现在从你这里拿了100个兽人战士之证。现在，继续战斗，直到你击败另外10000名兽人战士，让整个部落都承认你！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm? You don't seem to understand our way of life completely. It's strange that you are so curious about other races, human.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
嗯？你似乎没有完全理解我们的生活方式。作为一个人类，你对其他种族如此好奇，真是奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The best way of understanding the Orc tribe is to do battle with them. By competing in power and skills, eventually you will understand and respect your opponent.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
理解兽人部落的最好方式就是与他们战斗。通过力量和技巧的较量，最终你会理解并尊重你的对手。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
So, go outside and fight.
Although you may be learning theory by talking with me, you must experience our way of life for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
所以，出去战斗吧。
虽然你可以通过与我交谈来学习理论，但你必须亲自体验我们的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm? You don't seem to understand our way of life completely. It's strange that you are so curious about other races, human.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
嗯？你似乎没有完全理解我们的生活方式。作为一个人类，你对其他种族如此好奇，真是奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You've come back...
It doesn't seem that you've accomplished your goal yet, but I do not expect you to defeat 10,000 Orc Warriors so easily.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你回来了...
看起来你还没有达成目标，但我也不指望你能轻易击败10000名兽人战士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrrior]
If you wish, you may rest here. {0} victories over Orc Warriors are recognized by our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
如果你愿意，可以在这里休息。{0}场对兽人战士的胜利已被我们部落认可。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Do you wish to
record your current
victory with me?
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你想让我
记录你目前的
胜利吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: I will do it later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再做。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I hope you will
continue your efforts
in understanding the Orc
way of life through battle.
Don't give up.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我希望你能
继续努力，
通过战斗来理解兽人
的生活方式。
不要放弃。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
There are {0} battles ahead of you before you reach your goal. I understand the difficulty of this challenge, but I hope you make it.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
距离你达成目标还有{0}场战斗。我理解这个挑战的难度，但我希望你能成功。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now...
You won over
10,000 battles
with Orcs.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在...
你赢得了
10000场
与兽人的战斗。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
For a human, accomplishing such a feat is truly astonishing. Through all of that fighting, I'm sure that you have learned both good and bad things about my tribe.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
作为一个人类，能完成这样的壮举，真是令人惊叹。经历了这么多战斗，我相信你一定了解了我部族的许多事情，无论好坏。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although you're a
human, you have
demonstrated incredible
bravery and honor...
I shall grant you true
Orc Warrior status!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
虽然你是人类，但你展现了非凡的勇气与荣誉...
我将授予你真正的兽人战士身份！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You are now...
an Orc Warrior!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你现在是...
兽人战士了！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You are now...
an Orc Lady!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你现在是...
兽人女子了！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
This is a present for you. I am not sure if it will fit to your head or not, but try it. If your head is too big to wear this, I suggest that you carry this with you.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
这是给你的礼物。我不确定它是否适合你的头，但请试试看。如果你的头太大戴不上，我建议你就把它带在身边。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
As an Orc Warrior,
I will now give you
an Orcish Voucher
of your very own.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
作为兽人战士，
我现在将颁发给你
一张专属的兽人战士之证。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although it doesn't look different from the others, please keep this with care. You can only be recognized as an Orc warrior with this.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
虽然它看起来和其他的没什么不同，但请妥善保管。只有持有它，你才会被承认为兽人战士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, you may go back to where you have come from. Come drop by whenever my tribe comes to your mind.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在，你可以回到你来的地方了。每当想起我的部族，欢迎随时回来看看。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
As you are now one who feels the true intent of the opponent after endless battles, I will now return you to the battleground.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
既然你在无尽的战斗中，已经能够感知对手真正的意图，那么我现在就送你回到战场。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
I see, do as you wish.
I will be really disappointed in you if you quit in a challenge you have undertaken.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
我明白了，随你便吧。
如果你放弃了已经开始的挑战，我会对你非常失望的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Come take a rest here.
You have won {0} victories over Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
来这里休息一下吧。
你击败了{0}名兽人战士。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm? You don't think you cannot come back to where you originally came, just because now you're an Orc Warrior, do you? Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
嗯？你不会以为既然成为了兽人战士，就不能回到原来的地方了吧？哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Warrior...
May a fresh
light be with
you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
战士...
愿新的光芒
伴随你
征战沙场。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Show your opponents your indomitable spirit. Take pride in being a human that has been given the title of Orc Warrior!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
向你的对手展示你不屈的精神。为身为人类却获得兽人战士这一称号而感到自豪吧！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
My my...
Are you still
hungry for blood...?
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
哎呀...
你还
渴望鲜血...吗？

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You don't seem to be satisfied even after being recognized as a warrior. But... I suppose the path of the warrior is to seek new and more difficult challenges.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
即使被承认为战士，你似乎也不满足。不过...我想，战士的道路就是不断寻求新的、更艰难的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Okay, would you like to go through another test? It may reduce all your effort in coming here to nothing. Even seasoned Orc Warriors fear taking this test.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
好吧，你想再接受一次考验吗？这可能会让你之前的努力付诸东流。即使是经验丰富的兽人战士，也畏惧接受这项考验。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
But, since you're an exceptional case, it might be possible for you to accomplish...
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
不过，既然你是特例，也许你能成功...

scripts.text: I am already satisfied.
scripts.translation: 我已经心满意足了。

scripts.text: ...I will take this challenge.
scripts.translation: ...我会接受这个挑战。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Yes, that's a good
attitude. Sometimes,
you must accept your
limitations, or that
you cannot beat
certain opponents.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
是的，这是很好的态度。
有时候，你必须接受自己的局限，
或者承认自己无法战胜某些对手。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Excellent, I admire your enthusiasm. This is a very rare chance to do battle with the strongest Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
很好，我很欣赏你的热情。
这是一个非常罕见的机会，
可以与最强的兽人英雄们战斗。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Go fight with 100 Orc Heroes and bring me the tokens of the battles you have endured. Even if you're an excellent warrior, I assure you this test will be the hardest one you'll ever get.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
去与100名兽人英雄战斗，
并带给我你经历战斗的凭证。
即使你是优秀的战士，
我向你保证，这将是你遇到的最艰难考验。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, go, warrior! I believe that you have a chance to succeed. Fight with 100 Orc Heroes, and I will grant you, a human, recognition as an Orc Hero!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在，去吧，战士！
我相信你有成功的机会。
与100名兽人英雄战斗，
我将授予你，一个人类，兽人英雄的认可！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Warrior, may a fresh light be with you in battle. Show your opponents your indomitable spirit. Take pride in being a human that has been given the title of Orc Warrior!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
战士，愿新的光芒伴随你战斗。
向你的对手展示你不可征服的精神。
为身为被赋予兽人战士称号的人类而自豪吧！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Ah...
I knew you would succeed!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
啊...
我就知道你能成功！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The Orc Heroes who were defeated by you also must have recognized your courage. Thank you, human, for showing us what is true strength.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
被你击败的兽人英雄们，
想必也认可了你的勇气。
谢谢你，人类，向我们展示了什么是真正的力量。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
On behalf of
the Orc tribe,
let me pay
you homage.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
代表兽人部族，
让我向你致敬。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, make one last choice. What would you do with those Heroic Emblems? They might not be valuable to you humans, but for Orcs, they are treasured by those who own them.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在，做最后的选择。
你要如何处理那些兽人英雄之证？
它们可能对你们人类没有太大价值，
但对兽人来说，它们是持有者珍视之物。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Since you are the victor of those battles, you have every right to keep them. But you could also return them to the Orc Heroes, meaning that you wish to meet them in battle once again.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
既然你是那些战斗的胜利者，
你完全有权保留它们。
但你也可以将它们归还给兽人英雄，
这意味着你希望再次与他们战斗。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now, what would
you want to do
with the vouchers?
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
现在，你想
如何处理这些凭证？

scripts.text: I want to keep them.
scripts.translation: 我想保留它们

scripts.text: I shall return them to the Orc Heroes.
scripts.translation: 我会将它们归还给兽人英雄

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Yes, that's
not bad...
Not bad at all.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
是的，这很不错...
非常棒。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Nobody has the right to tell you what you can or cannot do. Please keep them as a memory of your victory.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
没有人有权告诉你什么能做或不能做。
请保留它们，作为你胜利的纪念。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
What a great attitude for a warrior...! It will be a model to other Orcs to show respect to opponents that you have defeated!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
多么伟大的战士态度...！
这将向其他兽人展示，
如何尊重你击败的对手！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
You deserve to be an Orc Hero, the most powerful Orc warrior! As of today, you are now an Orc Hero!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
你配得上成为兽人英雄，
最强大的兽人战士！
从今天起，你成为了兽人英雄！

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
This is a sword only given to our heroes. I am not sure if you can use this or not, but as an Orc Hero, you're obligated to carry this with you always.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
这是一把只授予我们英雄的剑。
我不确定你是否能使用它，
但作为兽人英雄，你有义务时刻携带它。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Now that you
are an Orc Hero,
let me give you
your own Heroic
Emblem.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
既然你成为了兽人英雄，
让我给你你自己的
兽人英雄之证。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Although it doesn't look different from the others, I hope you will keep it with care. You can only be recognized as an Orc Hero with this token.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
虽然它看起来与其他的一样，
但我希望你好好保管它。
只有持有这个凭证，你才能被认可为兽人英雄。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Then, you may leave now....
A human who has a better understanding than other humans. One who showed others power regardless of the race, I leave you to the future of Chaos.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
那么，你可以离开了...
一个比其他人更懂得道理的人类。一个不分种族、向他人展示力量的人，我将混沌的未来托付给你。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Hm...
Struggling, are you?
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
嗯...
你在挣扎吗？

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Well, Orc Hero is held in high regard by other Orcs for their great power. As a human, you will probably have difficulty in dealing with him.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
嗯，兽人英雄因其强大的力量而受到其他兽人的尊敬。作为人类，你大概很难对付他。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
However, you made the decision to go through with this test! Still, there's no need to rush it. Life is an endless series of battles, so the combat will come.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
不过，你决定接受这项考验！尽管如此，也不必急于求成。生命是一场无尽的战斗，战斗总会到来。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Warrior, where did you leave your Heroic Emblem? Without the token, I cannot recognize you as an Orc Hero. Please find it and keep it with you anywhere you go.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
战士，你把兽人英雄之证放在哪里了？没有这个凭证，我无法认可你是兽人英雄。请找到它，并随身携带。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
Warrior, where did you leave your sword? Without the sword, I cannot recognize you as an Orc Hero. Please find it and keep it with you anywhere you go.
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
战士，你把剑放在哪里了？没有这把剑，我无法认可你是兽人英雄。请找到它，并随身携带。

scripts.text:
[Orc Warrior]
The most
powerful warrior...
Orc Hero!
That's who you are!
May God be with you in battle!
scripts.translation:
[兽人战士]
最强大的战士...
兽人英雄！
那就是你！
愿神在战斗中与你同在！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您现在携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Stop bugging me
and get outta here!
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
别烦我了，快滚！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
If you wish to challenge me, wait inside the forest at the west. I'm not in the mood to deal with humans right now.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
如果你想挑战我，去西边的森林里等着。我现在没心情应付人类。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Now, hurry
up and scram!!
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
现在，赶紧滚蛋！！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Hm, are you the human who was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
嗯，你就是那个被授予兽人英雄身份的人类吗？

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I hope you know the meaning of returning my Emblem. I expect that we will meet again on the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
我希望你知道归还我徽章的意义。我期待我们在战场上再次相遇。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Wait...
Isn't that an Orc Warrior's Helm...?
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
等等...
那不是兽人战士的头盔吗...？

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Wait a second...
It's not! Ha...!
Interesting!
That's very
interesting.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
等一下...
不是！哈...！
有意思！
非常有意思。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I guess you don't know what's so special about this particular helm...
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
看来你不知道这顶头盔有什么特别之处...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
It actually belonged to one of our Orc Lords who was defeated by a human. He was so furious about losing that he broke the middle horn and threw it away!
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
它其实属于我们的一位兽人酋长，他被一个人类击败了。他因为输掉比赛而愤怒，折断了中间的角，然后把它扔掉了！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I was told that it somehow ended in the hands of a human, but I didn't know it was you, the human Orc Hero.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
我听说它不知怎么落到了人类手里，但我没想到是你，人类兽人英雄。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Alright, that belongs to the Orc Lord. I mean, even though it's now yours, it was given to you by mistake.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
好吧，那是兽人酋长的东西。我是说，虽然现在它是你的，但它是被错误地给你的。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Would you mind giving the item back to its owner, my human Orc Hero?
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
你介意把这件物品归还给它的主人吗，我的人类兽人英雄？

scripts.text: Yes, I mind.
scripts.translation: 介意

scripts.text: No, I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 不，我不介意。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Wow, you're so stubborn! Just treat the helm with care, and wear it with respect. Recognize that it has a long history...
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
哇，你真是固执！好好对待这顶头盔，戴着它要心怀敬意。要知道它有着悠久的历史...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Good, that's a good decision. I will give this back to him. Muhahahahaha... I didn't expect to see this thing again.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
很好，这是个明智的决定。我会把它还给他。穆哈哈哈哈哈...没想到还能再见到这东西。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Okay...
Let me give you
something useful!
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
好吧...
让我给你点有用的东西！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Although you're a human, you're an Orc Hero amongst us now, so you should have a helm suitable for your position...
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
虽然你是人类，但现在你也是我们中的兽人英雄，所以你应该有一顶符合你身份的头盔...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
There you go. I marked a small indication on it. So wear this helm from now on. Do you understand? My human Orc Hero.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
给你。我在上面做了个小标记。从今以后就戴这顶头盔吧。明白吗？我的人类兽人英雄。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Hm, are you the human who was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
嗯，你就是那个被授予兽人英雄身份的人类吗？

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
 I hope you know the meaning of returning my Emblem. I expect that we will meet again on the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
我希望你知道归还我徽章的意义。我期待在战场上再次与你相遇。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Hm, are you the human that was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
嗯，你是那个被授予兽人英雄称号的人类吗？

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Hmpf, I'm not convinced. Are you really the one who gave us our Emblems back? I don't think I can trust you...
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
哼，我不信。你真的是把徽章还给我们的人吗？我觉得我没法信任你...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Yeh, you would think I'd remember getting whupped by an ugly human, but I tend not to remember faces when I'm too busy getting whomped on.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
是啊，你肯定以为我会记得被一个丑陋的人类揍了一顿，但我忙着挨揍的时候，通常记不住脸。

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I refuse to
acknowledge someone
like you who forgets
our most basic customs!
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
我拒绝承认
像你这样
忘记我们
最基本习俗的人！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Grrrr...
Come on!
Let's meet outside west of the forest, and I'll test your strength again!
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
嘎吱...
来吧！
去森林西边外面见面，我再测试一下你的实力！

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
Muhahahaha~
You're the
strangest human
I've ever met.
Hahahahaha...
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
穆哈哈哈哈哈~
你是我见过的
最奇怪的人类。
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Orc Hero]
I like you,
human, I like you.
scripts.translation:
[兽人英雄]
我喜欢你，
人类，我喜欢你。
